description.zh: 駭客是一門非常廣泛的學科，涵蓋了廣泛的主題。 本課程將提供駭客攻防的各種概念，並解釋如何在即時環境中使用它們。本課程將包括駭客的類型，駭客的優勢 / 劣勢，駭客的目的，駭客的工具，駭客的技能，駭客的流程等。
description.en: Hacking is a very broad discipline, which covers a wide range of topics. This course will provide the various concepts of Ethical Hacking and explain how you can use them in a real-time environment.This course will include the type of hacking, advantage /disadvantage of hacking, the purpose of hacking, tools of hacking, skill of hacking, process of hacking, etc.

description.zh: 開源軟體 (open-source software) 對於資訊世界的發展極其重要，尤其是系統軟體與中介軟體。在 1990 年代快速發展的 GNU/Linux，1990 年代末期進入互連網時代，世界上最多伺服器使用的開源碼網頁伺服器 Apache HTTP Server 應運而生，之後更衍生出傳奇性的開源碼 Apache Project。迄今，各個開源碼社群持續改進、優化既有的軟體，並且不斷地開發出有巨大影響力的新計畫，包括廣泛用於建構雲端服務與巨量資料運算的 OpenStack、Hadoop 和 Spark，世界上最多人使用在智慧手機和平板的 Android 作業環境。開源系統軟體與中介軟體更成為物聯網和巨量資料分析時代的重要基礎，高效率、即時性、機器與機器之間良好的溝通與合作是這個時代應用開發的關鍵，除了需要有高效率、穩定、安全的作業系統之外，還需要更多高品質、優化度高的系統軟體與中介軟體。
description.en: Open-source software is extremely important to the development of the information world, especially system software and middleware. GNU/Linux developed rapidly in the 1990s and entered the Internet era in the late 1990s. The open-source web server Apache HTTP Server, which is used by the most servers in the world, came into being, and then the legendary open-source Apache Project was born. So far, various open-source communities have continued to improve and optimize existing software, and continue to develop new projects with great influence, including OpenStack, Hadoop and Spark, which are widely used to build cloud services and massive data computing. The most widely used Android work environment on smartphones and tablets. Open-source system software and intermediary software have become an important foundation in the era of Internet of Things and massive data analysis. High efficiency, immediacy, and good communication and cooperation between machines are the keys to application d

description.zh: 本課程介紹機器視覺之基本概念、原理及衍生應用，同時輔助以開放的影像函式庫來實作訓練；課程中由基礎的基本影像分析入門，並逐步導入機器視覺理論與方法，二維影像校正與立體視覺等內容；課程中將介紹機器視覺系統的相關資源與實作能力的培養，並進一步延伸至影像量測、機器學習與機器人領域的範例應用。
description.en: The field of machine vision has been growing at a fast pace. As in most developing fields, not all aspects of machine vision that are of interest to active researchers are useful to the designers and users of a vision system for a specific application. This course is intended to provide a balanced introduction to machine vision. Basic concepts are introduced with only essential mathematical elements. The details to allow implementation and use of vision algorithms in practical applications are provided, and engineering aspects of techniques are emphasized.

description.zh: 區塊鏈技術 (作為比特幣等數位貨幣的核心) 已重塑了金融交易與分散式交互方式之未來。同時它也被期待帶給我們一個更自組與可提供事實證明的數位化世界。抽象化區塊鏈構造是非常精巧的，它倚賴輕量化密碼學工具搭配分散式系統概念，完成了開放、安全且有效率的系統 (如比特幣)。本課程為區塊鏈技術與應用上之概念介紹，包含：比特幣與區塊鏈設計、相關基礎密碼學工具、分散式網路與共識、區塊鏈應用。
description.en: Blockchain techniques (the core of cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin) have reshaped the future of financial transactions and decentralized interactions. They are also expected to bring us a more self-organizing and dependent digital world. The abstraction of blockchain is very delicate. It relies on cryptography tools and decentralized system concepts to achieve an open, secure, and efficient system (such as Bitcoin). This course aims to introduce the concepts of blockchain techniques and applications, including Bitcoin and blockchain design, basic cryptography tools, decentralized networks and consensus, and blockchain applications.

notes: 資工四和資工所合開

description.zh: 本課程旨在教授學生瞭解雲端環境及物聯網系統架構並進一步教授雲端環境及物聯網安全需求，課程內容除介紹雲端環境及物聯網系統的基本概念外，亦將由 OWASP 的雲端安全及物聯網安全重點進行說明，培養學生有能力分析雲端及物聯網環境中的各式潛在安全威脅，並具備設計與實作具安全防護能力的雲端及物聯網系統。課程內容包含：●雲服務技術簡介●雲服務安全●雲服務資安標準●物聯網技術簡介●工業物聯網潛在威脅●工控資安●物聯網資安檢測●物聯網資安標準●資安安全與隱私保護
description.en: This course aims to guide students understanding cloud environments and IoT systems and their corresponding security requirements. In addition to introducing basic concepts of cloud environment and IoT system, the course contents will focus on OWASP's cloud security and IoT security. All practical techniques will be explained. Students are able to analyze various potential security threats in the cloud and Internet of Things environments, and to learn security protection capabilities for cloud and IoT systems. Course contents including:●Introduction to cloud technologies●Introduction to cloud security●Security standards for cloud services ●Introduction to IoT technologies●Potential threats of industrial IoT systems●Industrial Cyber Security introduction●IoT security detection●IoT security standards●Information security and privacy protection

notes: 電資外、資工四和資工所合開

description.zh: 資料科學是個跨領域的重要興新學科，其基本知識含括資訊、線性代數、機率與統計等，相關技術可應用在許多領域上，包含教育領域。本課程從學科整體介紹開始，討論資料科學中各主要階段的相關議題：包含資料搜尋擷取、資料整理與問題發想、數理知識回顧與討論、資料分析建模與方法、資料呈現與視覺化等。除課堂上講授與討論外，課程亦著重如何實際應用所學，將使用教育資料並以小組方式進行議題發想與分析實作的學期專題。此外，為強化健全資料視覺呈現課題，在實作專題中課程亦著重學生報告能力的培養，希望培育出全方位的資料科學人才。
description.en: Data science is an emerging interdisciplinary field that explores how to produce the valuable knowledge from large, multi-typed, or unstructured data and provides effective feedbacks to many applications, including education. The topics include data processing, data storage, statistics and probability, linear algebra, and data analysis. The course introduces the rapidly growing field, discusses the state-of-art techniques, and provides students with fundamental related knowledge and the ability to use software tools. The major phases on data manipulation-collection, preparation, analytics, and presentation, in data science will be discussed. The course training is toward equipping students with the mindset and the ability to solve problems with the learned techniques on educational data. In addition, students need to practice the presentation for the findings of the studied problem in order to equip with the ability to convey the thoughts well and demonstrate things visually.

name.zh: 資料科學原理與教育數據應用
name.en: Data Science Principles with Applications on Educational Data

notes: 電資外、資工四和資工所合開

description.zh: 本課程主要探索分析不實訊息的方法，透過這門課將學習到異常訊息、社交工程、傳播路徑及深度造假等對不實訊息分析的技術，包含語意分析、帳號識別分析及傳播路徑對不實訊息的影響分析。
description.en: This course is mainly to explore the methods of analyzing false information. Through this course, you will learn the techniques of analyzing false information, such as abnormal information, social engineering, propagation path and deep fake, including semantic analysis, account identification analysis and propagation path. Analysis of the impact of false information.

notes: 電資外、資工四和資工所合開

description.zh: Apple 推出 iPhone 以及 iPhone SDK 後，造成了一股不可擋的智慧型手機革命，由於相較於桌上型和筆記型電腦，手機是人們日常生活中更容易貼近使用的行動裝置，因此，手機中的 App 更可以幫助人們解決生活中的問題。本課程將由最基本的入門點切入，前段會先帶領同學針對 Objective-C 語法，委派設計 (Delegate) 模式等 iOS 入門的幾大難題上課，接著利用 Storyboard 建構出常見的 iOS app 使用者介面，最後再教導同學用 OpenGL es 實作有趣的 3D 應用程式。本課程大致如下：1. 導論 2. Objective-C3. iOS 系統架構 4.Xcode 開發工具安裝與使用 5. 基礎 UI 設計與多國語言 6. 核心應用程式設計 7. 感應器應用 8. 多媒體與相機功能 9. OpenGL ES10. 擴增實境 11. 專題實作及評鑑
description.en: In this course, you will get hands-on with the Apple SDK and learn how to use Objective-C to build the apps from scratch; You will be equipped to develop iOS apps, including 3D Apps through an understanding of the following course materials:˙Introduction to iOS˙How to program in Objective-C˙Using X-Code ˙The basics UI design of an iPhone/iPad application˙iOS MVC structure˙Use of sensors, the GPS, and cameras˙Multimedia functions – how to play audio and video files˙OpenGL ES for 3D/AR application˙Project Demo and Review˙How to publish an iPhone/iPad application

notes: 資工三、資工四和資工所合開

description.zh: 自主移動式機器人課程提供近年來在移動機器人的研究概況，以及相關的技術開發。本課程將將說明近三十年來領域發展歷史，讓同學了解包括機器人運動學、感測技術、定位與導航技術，以及實際應用的各項近期的進展。
description.en: Autonomous Mobile Robots presents an overview of technologies and methods for mobile robotics research. The specific goals of this course follow: 1. To provide historical context about mobile robotics, primarily over the past 30 years. 2. To enable students to study a chosen, specific mobile robotic technology. 3. To study state-of-the-art mobile robot research in detail.

notes: 電資外生和資工所合開

description.zh: 1. 組合分析 2. 機率公設 3. 條件機率與獨立 4. 離散隨機變數 5. 連續隨機變數 6. 結合分佈隨機變數 7. 期望值性質 8. 極限定理 9. 模擬
description.en: 1.Combinatorial Analysis 2.Axioms of Probability3.	Conditional Probability and Independence4.Discrete Random Variables5.Continuous Random Variables6.Jointly Distributed Random Variables7.Properties of Expectation 8.Limit Theorems 9.Simulation

notes: 本班 EMI 英文授課、資工二和電資二合開，中英文二擇一

description.zh: 在各種應用領域中，非結構化的文件相當普遍。如何精確有效地從文件中擷取出重要資訊並分析語意，將有助於彙整不同想法。本課程介紹基本的自然語言處理技術，包括：語彙組成、語法分析、語意分析等，以及常見的文件探勘方法。除了介紹詞性標註 (POS tagging)、關鍵詞擷取 (keyterm extraction)、中文斷詞 (word segmentation) 之外，也將探討不同的字詞與文件表達方式，並應用深度學習方法進行有效的語意分析，如：情緒分析、意見探勘等。
description.en: Unstructured text docuemnts are very common in various applicaton domains. How to extract important information from texts and analyze their meanings is very helpful to aggregate various ideas. In this course, we are going to introduce the basic techniques in Natural Language Processing including: lexical, syntactic, and semantic anlaysis, and common text mining methods. In addition to POS tagging, keyterm extraction, and word segmentation, we are going to discuss different word and document representations, and apply deep learning methods in effective semantic analysis such as sentiment analysis and opinion mining.

name.zh: 自然語言處理與文件探勘
name.en: Natural Language Processing and Text Mining

description.zh: 1. 數學基礎 1.1 函數成長率之漸近性質 1.2 遞迴關係之解        1.3 數學歸納法 2. 基本分析技巧 2.1 計算複雜度之上下限 2.2 最差情況分析及平均情況分析 2.3 動態平均分析 3. 基本設計技巧 3.1 分擊法 3.2 貪婪法 3.3 動態規劃 3.4 隨機演算法 4. 計算複雜度 4.1 資訊理論證明法 4.2 對抗式證明法 4.3 問題之線性轉換 4.4 完全 NP
description.en: 1. Mathematical background 1.1 Asymptotic growth rate of functions 1.2 Solving recurrence relations 1.3 Mathematical induction 2. Basic analysis techniques 2.1 Computational complexities -- lower bounds and upper bounds 2.2 Worst case analysis and average case analysis 2.3 Amortized analysis 3. Basic Design Paradigms 3.1 Divide and conquer 3.2 Greedy methods 3.3 Dynamic programming 3.4 Probabilistic algorithms 4. Computational Complexity 4.1 Information-theoretic arguments 4.2 Adversary arguments 4.3 Linear reduction of problems 4.4 NP-completeness

name.en: Design and Analysis of Computer Algorithms

notes: 資工四、資工所、電資外生和資安學位學程合開

description.zh: 本課程將討論材料熱力學與動力學之間的差異與擴散理論。課程最後會介紹動力學在工業界的應用實例：金屬熱處理與粉末燒結理論。
description.en: This lecture will discuss the differences between Thermodynamics and Kinetics and also discuss the Diffusion Theory. At the end of this lecture, we will introduce the applications of Kinetics in industry cases: Metal Heat Treatment and Theory of Sintering.

notes: 材資三四乙合開

description.zh: 將熱力學定律應用於計算凝結相之化學位能與其平衡，逸壓和活性因素，溶液熱力學，多元金屬溶液，相圖和相變化，運用電腦模擬相反應和相圖，及研擬冶金數學模式。
description.en: It applies the theory of thermaldynamics to calculate chemical potential energy andits equilibrium of condensed phase, released pressure and activated factors, solutionthermaldynamics, complex metal solution , phase diagram and phase change,computer-aided phase reaction and phase diagram simulation, and planning amathmatics model of metallurgy.

notes: 材資二三乙合開

description.zh: 這門課除了教授傳統企業環境管理及相關實務之外，特別將著重在企業提升如何透過綠色創新來提升綠色競爭力的策略與做法；此外，課程另一重點將會是企業如何透過協助聯合國永續發展目標 (UN SDGs) 的達成，來創造企業的永續競爭力。學生將會深入探究金字塔底層 (BOP) 與創造共享價值 (Creating Shared Value, CSV) 之理論及實務做法，以及成為一個真正永續企業的策略。
description.en: In this course, traditional corporate environmental management and the strategies for improving green competitiveness will be taught. In addition, the strategies of corporate sustainability- how the corporate to create sustainable competitiveness by coping with the 17 goals of UN’s Sustainable Development Goals (UN SDGs) will also be taught. Theories and practices of Bottom of the Pyramid (BOP) and Creating Shared Value (CSV), as well as the strategies of being a true sustainable enterprise will be emphasized in the class.

description.zh: 室內空氣品質及室內空氣污染對人體之危害、空氣環境汙染物、換氣與通風、檢測方法、污染源診斷、空氣品質控制及改善、國內外法規、管理計劃規劃。含室內空氣污染物之移除技術、室內空氣清淨機原理應用於室內空氣品質之控制。
description.en: Indoor and outside air conditions, air pollutants, fresh air and air conditioning & ventilation, indoor air quality control, management and regulation, indoor air cleaners.

name.zh: 室內空氣品質控制與管理
name.en: Indoor Air Quality Control and management

description.zh: 本課程之主旨在於加強學生對薄膜處理程序之深入了解，以作為進一步對水質管理應用之基礎。薄膜的種類介紹包括薄膜逆滲透、奈米薄膜、超過濾、微過濾、前驅滲透、電透析以及薄膜生物處理。基本理論包括薄膜前處理、質量傳輸、積垢、結構、薄膜阻塞及清理、後處理及實務應用。
description.en: This class will provide graduate student authoritative information on the current knowledge of membrane process for water treatment, including reverse osmosis, nanofiltration, ultrafiltration, microfiltration, forward osmosis, electrodialysis and membrane bioreactor. The theories include pretreatment, mass transfer, fouling, scaling, membrane cleaning, post treatment and practical application.

description.zh: 本課程介紹統計學、計量經濟學之基本概念，旨在培養學生理解數據、進而分析數據能力。課程理論與實務並重，採理論講授、上機實作交替方式進行，確保學生在實務上應用統計理論之能力。透過修習本課程，學生可將統計概念應用於自然科學領域之實驗數據整理，或社會科學領域之巨量資料分析，培養具備跨領域問題分析能力之學生。
description.en: This course aims to develop the ability to understand and analyze environmental problems through the basic concept of statistics and econometrics. Both lectures regarding theories and practical lessons on computer are included in this course to make sure students’ ability of application in the future. Skills taught in this course can be applied in both natural science and social science, thus enhancing students’ interdisciplinary potential.

description.zh: 本課程討論，利用儀器分析工作之理論，儀器之原理，構造操作及計算等。包括光譜化學，原子吸收光譜，電漿發射光譜儀，發光光譜儀，電分析化學，PH 計，電解沉澱法，伏安法，極譜儀，等儀器之探討。
description.en: This course discusses the theoryof instrumental analysis operation, the principle of instrument, structural operation and calculation. It includes spectrum chemistry, atomic absorption spectrograph, plasma jet spectrograph, light spectrograph, electric analytic chemistry, PH meter, electrolytic precipatation, volt ampere, polar spectrograph, etc..

description.zh: 固態元件簡介，功能電子陶瓷 (functional ceramics); 同時可對某些物理量如壓，力，音，濕度，溫度，氣體等產生響應，故其亦可稱為感測陶瓷 (sensing ceramics). 精密電子陶瓷課程內容將對日常生活常見之介電陶瓷，壓電陶瓷，焦電陶瓷，半導體陶瓷及磁性陶瓷等部分作深入淺出介紹.
description.en: It may also be called as Solid-state Devices and "functional ceramics" because of the special function applied in practical circuits; through the responses caused by pressure, force, sound, moisture, temperature and different gas, the fine electronic ceramics may also be called "sensing ceramics". In this course, the dielectric ceramics, piezoelectric ceramics, pyroelectric ceramics, semiconducting ceramics and magnetic ceramics will be introduced with their applications.

notes: 材資三四甲合開

description.zh: 本課程內容目的在介紹電化學之原理與其應用。一、在原理方面包括離子之作用及其平衡，電解質之導電性質，界面現象，電極電位，電化學電池和電極動力程序等內容。二、在應用方面則涵蓋溶液化學參數測量，電化學分析技術，電鍍，表面處理，金屬腐蝕防治，電池應用，和電合成等
description.en: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to principles of electrochemistry and its applications. In the principles which includes ionic interaction, ionic equilibrium, the conducting properties of electrolytes, interfacial phenomena, electrode potentials, electrochemical cells and electrode kinetic process. For the application covers determination of physical parameters in the solutions, electroanalytical techniques, electroplating, electrochemical sensors, surface finishing, metal corrosion prevention, cells, electrodialysis, and electrosynthesis etc.

notes: 材資三四甲合開

description.zh: 課程綱要：1. 高分子結構及其物理性質 2. 高分子定性與分析 3. 高分子流變學 4. 高分子複合材料
description.en: Course Outline：1.Polymeric Structure and its Properties2.Characterization and Analysis of  Polymers3.Rheology of Polymers4.Polymeric Composite Materials

notes: 材資三四甲合開

description.zh: 粉末冶金是工業先進國家積極發展的重點科技之一，其內容涵蓋粉末製造、粉末成形固結以及燒結體的後處理等範圍，本課程即安排包括粉末製造、粉末特性與其測定、粉末混合與造粒、成形、燒結理論與實務、燒結體性質與其測定、燒結體的後處理等基礎項目。另外，再講述利用粉末冶金技術製造的材料與產品的實務應用項目等，以期讓學生能對粉末冶金技術能有基本上的認識。
description.en: Powder metallurgy is one of the most important highlighted high-tech in the developed countries, its content includes powder making,powder formation and condensing,and the final treatment of sintered body,etc.Thus, this course includes the fundamental items such as powder manufacturing, powder characteristics and its test, powder mixing and granulation, formation, sintering theory and practice, the property of sintering body and its test, the post-treatment of sintering body. Besides, it also lectures practice method like using powder metallurgy to manufacture material and product, in order to let students have basic knowledge about powder metallurgy.

notes: 材資三四甲合開

description.zh: 介紹工程成本運算的各種方法，藉由不同的數學分析技巧，推估並了解                                         不同工程資金運用方案的差異性，以為決策評估及成本控制的依據。
description.en: Introduction the methods of engineering cost calculate.

notes: 材資三四甲合開

description.zh: 本課程介紹現代矽奈米之元件物理與其操作原理，課程主題涵蓋金屬 / 半導體接面、能帶圖、金氧半電容元件、金氧半場效電晶體、金氧半場效電晶體之微縮、先進金氧半場效電晶體與其製程技術。
description.en: This course provides an introduction to the fundamental physics and operation principles of silicon-based nano devices in modern electronics. This class will cover topics include metal/semiconductor junctions, energy band diagrams, MOS capacitors, MOS field-effect transistors (MOSFETs). MOSFET scaling, modern MOSFETs, and future transistor technologies will also be discussed.

notes: 材資四甲和材料所合開

description.zh: 半導體晶片封裝及微電子元件構裝技術是將積體電路和其它電元件，依設計聯結在一系統中，再以構裝材料將晶片、基座及釘架封包。本課程將介紹陶瓷構裝和高分子構裝、及其相關技術、與工業現況。
description.en: Semiconductor chip packaging and microelectronic packaging is the critical technology to allow the chips be incorporated into an individual protective package, mounted with other components in hybrid or multichip modules, or connected directly onto a printed circuit board. This course will introduce both ceramic packaging and polymer packaging and their corresponding technology.

class.name: 能源光電外國學生專班

notes: 網路預選限 15 人 (研究所)；化工所 EOMP 合開

description.zh: 本課程主要介紹薄膜製作有關的基礎理論與技術。講述內容包括真空技術，薄膜基礎，薄膜製作技術，蝕刻技術，薄膜評估方法以及薄膜技術的應用等。讓學生認識薄膜在高科技產業上的應用與其重要性，製作薄膜的方法與技術以及其未來的發展。
description.en: This course is a special topics of Thin films technology and Thin film materials science. 2. Vacuum science and technology 3. Thin film evaporation processes 4. Discharge, plasma, and ion-surface interaction 5. Plasma and ion beam processing of thin films 6. Chemical vapor deposition 7. Substrate surfaces and thin film nucleation 8. Film structure 9. Characterization of thin films and surface 10. Interdiffusion, reactions, and transformations in thin films 11. Mechanical properties of thin films.

description.zh: 內容包括材料彈塑性變形，差排，高溫變形，低溫拉伸破壞，高溫破壞及疲勞。
description.en: The contents include elastic and plastic deformation in materials，dislocations，high temperature deformation，tensile fracture at low temperature，high temperature fracture and fatigue。

description.zh: 主要介紹結構陶瓷，生醫陶瓷，複合陶瓷等。
description.en: This course is a special topics of Structural Ceramics.

description.zh: 本課程介紹現代矽奈米之元件物理與其操作原理，課程主題涵蓋金屬 / 半導體接面、能帶圖、金氧半電容元件、金氧半場效電晶體、金氧半場效電晶體之微縮、先進金氧半場效電晶體與其製程技術。
description.en: This course provides an introduction to the fundamental physics and operation principles of silicon-based nano devices in modern electronics. This class will cover topics include metal/semiconductor junctions, energy band diagrams, MOS capacitors, MOS field-effect transistors (MOSFETs). MOSFET scaling, modern MOSFETs, and future transistor technologies will also be discussed.

notes: 材資四甲和材料所合開

description.zh: 資料表示法：定點系統 (fixed point system)，浮點系統 (floating point system)，2. 運算工作：定點之加減乘除，快速之運算，浮點運算，3. 指令與控制：各種指令介紹，中斷，硬體控制單元設計 (hardwired control)，微程式控制單元設計 (microprogramming)，4. 記憶系統：記憶體之層次 (memory hierarchy)，虛擬記憶系統 (virtual memory)，快速記憶 (cache memory)。
description.en: 1. data representation (fixed point and floating point systems) 2. arithmetic and logic operations 3. command and control (hardwired control and microprogramming) 4. memory organization (cache and virtual memory)

notes: 限重補修生 (新舊時序調整，已通過同學不得重複修習)

description.zh: 本課程在視覺心理學的架構下，從設計的角度來檢視視覺、知覺、心理物理學、心理實驗學與視錯覺等的基礎理論與設計應用。
description.en: This course investigates the fundamental theories of visual perception through the lens of design. Topics include vision, perceptual process, space perception, psychophysics, and visual illusion.

notes: 一般教室 (45 人) 大二 / 外生二合開，限本系 30 人

description.zh: 本課程主要的目標為從應用與設計的角度，切入虛擬實境產業的各種可能性。從教育應用、設計工具以及虛擬實境遊戲設計、虛擬實境互動式動畫製作等，進行探討。
description.en: The main objective of the program, is taking from the application and design perspective, cut into the possibilities of virtual reality industry. Exploring from the educational applications, design tools and virtual reality games, to virtual reality interactive animation, etc.

notes: 一般教室 (50), 預選限 13 人，大三 / 外生三 / 日碩 / 外碩合開

description.zh: 基於學生畢業後的生涯發展，本課程目標旨在提供學生清楚認知未來的生涯發展，進而規劃自己的進路。針對設計學生畢業後的發展可以從學術界與實務界兩方面考量，學術界以直升研究所或工作後再修讀在職專班，而實務界則以可從事的相關職場做介紹與分析各行業的特色與前途，可擔任的職務名稱包括：互動設計師、互動程式設計師、使用者介面設計師、互動廣告企劃等，以供學生參考。
description.en: Based on the personal career development,  the course aims to provide a clearly scope and knowledge of future career development. This career can be analyzed in two categories, one is academic field that provide the master program and in-job training program; the another is practical field which concerns about more related design job, such as interaction designer, interactive programmer, user interface designer and interactive advertisement planner. This course not only introduces the design-related job, but also analyzes their characteristics and future development route.

notes: 一般教室，修課上限 30 人

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於介紹台灣數位學習現況，並透過數位學習理論的講授以及設計實務的操作，使學生能具備行動裝置應用程式原型的實務開發能力。而互動科技應用於互動學習平台上，含 HTML5、CSS3、RWD、JavaScript 等程式語言，學生能夠熟悉此技能，並且應用於互動網頁的開發。
description.en: The aim of this course is to introduce the current situation of Taiwan's digital learning, and through the teaching of digital learning theory and the implementation of the design practice, which enables students to have practical development capabilities for mobile device application prototypes. Such interactive technology used in interactive learning platform, including HTML5, CSS3, RWD, JavaScript programming languages. Therefore, students are familiar with this skill and apply it to interactive web development.

notes: 限 30 人，計中電腦教室，外生三 / 大四合開

description.zh: 「Forecasting isn’t prediction.」- Paul Saffo 未來思考與趨勢前瞻，有助於讓每一位同學思索未來社會可能轉變得新趨勢和新的需求。無論同學希望學習或專精的技能為何，如何應用 該技能，提前 選擇一個在未來對社會或個人更可能有所助益的方向練習、實作，不斷繼續前進，才能夠將個人的意義進一步投射至未來的社會價值中；如此一來，未 來社會也將會給給予你應有的報酬。未來思考的課程，將師承奇點大學客座教授，同時也是美國史丹佛大學設計學院特聘助理教授 Paul Saffo 的 Forecasting 課程，內容將有 - 現況觀察、趨勢分析、未來事件辯論、未來趨勢矩陣圖、前瞻思考經典賞析（包含文章與電影） 等。
description.en: 「Forecasting isn’t prediction.」- Paul SaffoFuture Studies & Forecasting will be more and more important skill for every young generation students. What will the future look alike? What is the driving forces pushing us from current to the future? How many pace layers of future arrivals?In this class, we will discuss Stanford consulting prof. Paul Saffo’s Future Studies & Forecasting methods, by – Observing current trends, future event debate, Matrices and Axes of Uncertainty, future mindset developing, etc.

notes: 進修教室，限 30 人，日碩 / 職碩 / 設計博合開

description.zh: 本課程主要的目標為從應用與設計的角度，切入虛擬實境產業的各種可能性。從教育應用、設計工具以及虛擬實境遊戲設計、虛擬實境互動式動畫製作等，進行探討。
description.en: The main objective of the program is taking from the application and design perspective, cutting into the possibilities of the virtual reality industry. Exploring from the educational applications, design tools and virtual reality games, to virtual reality interactive animation, etc.

notes: 一般教室 (50), 碩預選限 7 人，大三 / 外生三 / 日碩 / 外碩合開

description.zh: 本課程旨在講授互動式廣告的規劃與製作原理，包括互動式媒體的特性、廣告製作可如何掌握、發揮互動式媒體的特性，以及建置、設計、發展、與維護互動式廣告所需的相關概念、科技與技能。本課程亦教導同學如何應用電腦影像（computer imaging）與多媒體的科技與技術，來製作互動式廣告。
description.en: This course is mainly about the planning and principles of interactive advertisement production such as features of interactive media, how can advertisement production control and develop the features of interactive media, as well as the related concepts, technology, and skills needed in order to build, design, develop, and maintain interactive advertisement. Students will learn how to use computer imaging and the technology and techniques of multi-media to make an interactive advertisement.

notes: 排進修教室，限 14 人，日職合開

description.zh: 本課程聚焦於未來智慧互動城市發展的理論、方法、技術應用與案例分析。在智慧城市中，民眾透過主動、被動、自主和社群平台進行交流和合作，以實現不同的生活目標。學生將獲得有關智慧互動城市領域主要研究主題和實驗實踐的知識，培養她 / 他在建設智慧互動城市方面的技能。課程內容主要將從互動和設計的角度介紹和討論不同的範例，例如普適計算、環境智能、增強和虛擬現實、環境智能、可適化人機介面、操作性介面、物聯網、智慧家居、社會規範、及空間感知… 等的應用情境與案例分析。與課程中，也將帶入不同的社會挑戰，並於學生分組專題，透過跨領域共作的模式，提出未來互動設計應用與智慧城市的方案。本課程將分為理論部分和實踐部分。理論部分涵蓋了開發和評估智慧互動系統的理論架構和方法，以及其實踐與應用方法。理論部分的部分內容將透過分組專題，同時學習理論的內容及其應用實踐的實務。
description.en: The main theme of the course is theories, methods, technologies and case studies for the development of future smart interactive cities where humans and proactive, reactive, autonomous and social platform communicate and cooperate to reach goals. The student will acquire knowledge about main research themes and experimental practices in the field of smart interactive cities as well as develop her/his skills in constructing and smart interactive cities. Different paradigms will be introduced and discussed, primarily from an interaction and design perspective such as ubiquitous computing, ambient intelligence, augmented and virtual reality, intelligent and adaptive user interfaces, tangible interfaces, persuasive technology, decision-support systems, Internet of Things, smart homes, social norms, and spatial awareness. Different societal challenges will also be addressed through cross-disciplinary collaboration in student projects. The course is divided into a theoretical part and a prac

notes: 1 週【停開】

description.zh: 本課程將以問題導向學習 (Problem-based Learning) 的模式，學習設計思考的五個核心步驟：同理心分析、問題定義、創意發想、雛型發展、驗證評估。並透過實際案例的分析與操作，學習互動設計跨領域創新的方法。本課程的主要目標在於提供學生：1. 了解互動設計的方法與步驟；2. 探討互動設計跨領域創新的方法與操作模式；3. 透過實務案例的操作累積互動設計的執行經驗。
description.en: This course will use Problem-based Learning (PBL) method to teach the five kernel steps of design thinking including the following: Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, and Test. It will also help students in knowing the interdisciplinary innovation methods of interaction design by case studies and real case operation. The main course goals include the following: gain an understanding of the methods and steps of interaction design; explore the methods and operation models for the interdisciplinary innovation of interaction design; and gain the experiences of interaction design by real cases analysis and operation.

notes: PBL 教室，限 20 人，互動日碩 / 外碩 / 設計博合開

description.zh: 本課程主要的目標為從應用與設計的角度，切入虛擬實境產業的各種可能性。從教育應用、設計工具以及虛擬實境遊戲設計、虛擬實境互動式動畫製作等，進行探討。

description.zh: 先修課程：4402012 或負責教授同意介紹各種不同方法分析（如能量法及 Castigliano 定理），破壞理論，材料選用，可靠度概念，軸及軸承，離合器及煞車器，傳動元件（如皮帶、鏈條、齒輪），軸聯接器，飛輪，彈簧等。
description.en: Introduction to Analysis Methods (Energy method & Castigliano theorem), Failure Theory, Material Selection, Introduction to Reliability, Shafts and Bearings, Clutches and Brakes, Power Transmission Elements (Belts, Chains, Gears), Couplings, Flywheels, Springs.

description.zh: 介紹各種潔淨且高效率的先進車輛動力系統的型式及其工作原理並分析技巧。項目包含車輛能源所面臨的一些問題及可能的解決方案、優良動力源的特性、電動系統、複合電動系統、複合氣動系統、氫燃料電池動力系統、金屬燃料電池動力系統、各種替代性燃料的特性及優缺點、太陽光電輔助動力系統等。
description.en: This course introduces various kinds of clean and high-efficiency vehicular power systems, their operation principles, and analytical skills.  Topics include: problems and possible solutions the vehicular power system faces, characteristics of a good vehicular power system, electric power system, hybrid electric power system, hybrid pneumatic power system, fuel cell power system, metallic fuel-cell power system, substitutive fuels, and solar-energy auxiliary power system.

name.en: Special Topics on Clean Power System

notes: 日、職車輛所合開，1 週【停開】

description.zh: 噪音基礎，噪音分析實驗法，汽車噪音法規與標準，基本噪音控制程序，車輛噪音與噪音控制基本，引擎噪音與控制，車輛噪音源，車輛噪音與改良，心理聲學與最佳化
description.en: Fundamentals of Acoustics, Experimental Methods of Acoustic Analysis, Automotive Noise Legislation and Standards, Basic Noise Control Procedure, Basics of Vehicle Noise and Noise Control, Engine Noise and Its Control, Vehicle Noise Sources, Vehicle Noise and Its Refinement, Psychoacoustic Analysis and Optimizations.

notes: 日、職車輛所合開

description.zh: 本課程以介紹複合動力車輛概念、設計、能量分析及最佳化控制為主，結合內燃機及馬達兩種複合動力之能量管理及配合道路狀況，教導學生熟識複合車輛動力系統。
description.en: This course presents fundamentals of Hybrid Electric Vehicles: HEV concepts and design, energy analysis, unified modeling approach, optimization and control.  The power consumption side of vehicles. Conventional power generation: IC engine overview, concepts of hybridization, general model of energy form and energy flows, on-board energy storage (fuels and batteries). Overview of electrochemical converters: motors, transmissions for HEVs, principles of fuel cells, HEV application. Principles of energy optimization in HEVs.

description.zh: 本課程教授系統分析之模擬方法應用於能源動力系統之穩態與動態分析 (malab)。內容包括能源系統個元件之特性分析與數學模型介紹，系統元件包括；壓縮機、渦輪機、熱交換器、與質子交換膜燃料電池系統。授課單元如下；1. 數值方法介紹 2. 能源系統元件數學模型與程式撰寫壓縮機   渦輪機   熱交換器 3. 能源系統分析範例；燃料電池系統分析流道 model、氣體擴散層 model、燃料電池質傳與電化學傳輸與程式範例
description.en: The course is a system analysis method for performing steady-state and dynamic system simulations of lumped component system (matlab). These methods are essentially a numerical analysis; the course teach student to set up various system composed of; compressor, turbine, heat exchanger, reformer and fuel cell system. Course lectures are listed as:1.Numerical method 2.System components modeling Compressor   Turbine   Heat exchanger3.Case study of energy system; fuel cell system analysisFlow modeling, GDL model, mass & charge transport and programing

notes: 日、職車輛所、車輛能源外生和機電博班合開

description.zh: 先修課程： 無。本實習內容為汽車底盤實習，包含底盤綜合保養檢修、轉向懸吊及煞車系統元件拆裝調整檢修、檢修調整汽車前輪定位、拆裝輪胎總成及校正平衡、操作使用底盤動力計、煞車及偏滑實驗儀器。
description.en: Automobile Chassis Service Shop Practice , the basic inspection, adjustment and repair of Automobile Chassis System, Include the Automobile Suspension systems, Steering systems and Braking systems, Tire Repair and Balance practice, Wheel-Alignment practice , Chassis dynamometer Experiment , Brake performance and Slide Test .

notes: 車輛一、二、三、四合開 綜科 B1 車輛教學研究中心

description.zh: 本課程以落地產業應用技術爲主題，導入德國工業大學任務導向學習模式，課程教導學生從建置雲端資料庫伺服器到撰寫三機一體網頁控制程式進行工廠 CPS 產銷戰情資訊管理系統，串聯工廠人機物料及生產線與品管，並實務教導開發 AI 瑕疵檢測模型，再利用人機操控 PLC 達到機聯網，進行工廠整廠資訊連線。
description.en: The theme of this course is industrial application technology, and it introduces the task-oriented learning model of the German University of Technology. The course teaches students from building a cloud database server to writing a three-in-one web control program for factory CPS production and sales information management system, connecting factories Human-machine material, production line and quality control, and practical teaching and development of AI defect detection model, and then use human-machine control PLC to achieve machine networking, and conduct factory-wide information connection.

name.zh: 數位製造結合 AI 科技應用 (二)
name.en: Digital manufacturing integrated with AI technology application II

notes: 機械三四合開，限 60 人

description.zh: 於 2009 年，ASTM 定義了積層製造，並將此積層製造分成七大類型，本課程將對其中的光聚合固化及材料擠製技術進行軟硬體材料的剖析，並導入實作。本課程鼓勵學生在修課後，參加 IPAS 3D 列印實作考科之工程師級考試。
description.en: ASTM Committee F42 on Additive Manufacturing Technologies was formed in 2009. The myriad process names into seven standardized terms. In this course, the processes of Vat Photopolymerization and Material Extrusion, hardware, software, and material will be studied, The implementation of these two type systems will be given. The course will encourage students to take IPAS exam in 3D Printing practice.

notes: 機械三四合開，億光 4 樓 IPAS 3D 列印實作基地，限 24 人

description.zh: 導論及 AI 之工業應用、類神經網路及專家系統搜尋法則、敘述邏輯、驗證、機器學習。
description.en: Introduction of AI in industrial applications, Neural Networks, Searching algorithm of expert systems, Statement logic, Testing, Machine learning.

notes: 機械三四合開，限 50 人

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。精密量測學概論、長度量測、角度量測、量規設計、幾何誤差量測（含直線度、平行度、垂直度、真圓度、平面度）、光學平鏡、光學投影機、三次元量測、齒輪檢測儀、工具機檢測。
description.en: Metrology Introduction, distance measurements, angular measurements, the design of limit gauges, measurement of geometrical tolerance (straightness, parallelism, squareness, roundness, flatness, etc.), optical plate, profile projector, coordinate measuring machine, gear measurements, machine tool metrology.

notes: 機械大一合開期末部分課程教室將在機械系量測實驗室及

description.zh: 精確度、重覆性、精密度及解析度等、彈性變形及動態特性、背隙摩擦及動態特性、系統補償、精密機構及動態分析。
description.en: Accuracy, Repeatability, Precision and Resolution; Elastic Deformation, Backlash, Friction and their Dynamic Properties; System Compensation; precision Mechanisms and Dynamic Analysis.

description.zh: 本課程涵蓋的範圍包括基礎的雷射物理與工程、雷射光束的傳播、高斯雷射光束、光學共振腔的原理、設計與分析等等。內容包含：1. 基本光學  2. 雷射基本原理  3. 各種雷射介紹  4. 雷射動態特性  5. 雷射的應用
description.en: The lectures will cover the fundamental aspects of laser physics and engineering of lasers of all kinds, including ray tracing, Gaussian beams, principles of the optical cavities design and analysis...etc. The lecture outline is as follows:1.Basic optics  2. Laser principles  3. Specific types of lasers  4. Laser dynamics  5. Laser applications

notes: 限 50 人

description.zh: 硬體簡介、影像處理 (單色、彩色、3D 及即時)、圖案識別 (Patten Recognition)、機械視覺於順序控制之應用、機械視覺於回授控制之應用、高速檢測、機械人與機械視覺之結合及應用。
description.en: Introduction to Hardware of Vision System, Image Processing (Monochrome, Color, 3D and real-time), Pattern Recognition, Application of MV to Sequential Control Application of MV to Feedback Control. High Speed Inspection, Combined Applications of Robotics and MV.

notes: 計中電腦教室，限 30 人

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。精密機械之機械控制，電氣控制，數值控制，幾何數據處理，驅動系統，適應控制系統，監視系統與診斷系統，機器人控制，電腦整合精密機械系統．
description.en: Mechanical control, electrical control, numerical control, geometric data processing, drive systems, adaptive control systems, monitoring and diagnostic systems, Computer Integrated precision Machinery Systems.

notes: 製科所必選課程之一 / 限 20 人

description.zh: 機械振動、非線性振動、振動量測、振動抑制及隔離技術、振動與波之傳播、聲音之反射及折射、噪音之降低及吸音材料、消音器與噪音控制、法規及環境等。
description.en: Topics include: Mechanical vibration, Vibration  transmission, Vibration measurement, The use of vibration isolators and absorbers, Fundamentals of acoustics, Noise control engineering, Instrumentation and Law.

notes: 1 週【停開】

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。生物力學基礎，基本應用力學與生物力學之異同，生物力學之靜力學原理與應用，生物力學之運動學原理與應用，生物力學之動力學原理與應用，生物力學之材料力學原理與應用。
description.en: Principles and Applications of Statics in Biomechanics, Principles and Applications of Kinematics in Biomechanics, Principles and Applications of Dynamics in Biomechanics, Principles and Applications of Mechanics of Material in Biomechanics.

notes: 機械三四合開，限 40 人

description.zh: 先修課程：3002013 或負責教授同意。簡易連桿組之合成（圖解法與解析法）、耦曲線在設計上之應用、同耦曲線族、機構之靜力與動力分析、轉子之平衡、機構之平衡、飛輪設計、引擎動力學與平衡、凸輪動力學、臨界轉速、球面與空間連桿組之簡介。
description.en: Synthesis of Four-bar linkage (Graphical and Analytical Method) , Application of Coupler careers in Design , coupler cognate Mechanisms static and dynamic analysis of Mechanisms. Balancing Rotating Masses, Flywheels, Balancing Reciprocating Masses, dynamics of Cams, critical Whirling speeds, Introduction of spherical and spatial linkages.

notes: 機械三四合開，計中電腦教室，限 50 人

description.zh: 本課程為本校「智慧鐵道學程」的進階基礎課程。課程開授之目標，是希望藉由先進智慧鐵道系統的介紹，使修課學生能夠清楚瞭解鐵道產業的未來發展方向，並引領學生積極投入各種先進智慧鐵道應用系統之研究。本課程是以同時段合院授課的方式、針對選讀學程之學生、邀請智慧鐵道系統相關、學有專精的技術研發人員、以業師的身份共同參與授課。本課程會要求修課同學於期末報告時進行實作系統的展示，並邀請鐵道產業專家擔任評審。修習本課程前，不同學系之學生須先修習的課程清單另訂定之。
description.en: This course is one of the advanced core courses for the Intelligent Railway Curriculum. The aim of this course is, via the introduction of advanced intelligent rail system, to have the students realize thoroughly the development trend of futuristic rail industry, and subsequently, to encourage the students into the research and development of various application systems for intelligent railway. This course is a joint lecture among departments inside our college with synchronized class hours. The industrial instructors to our participant students include R&D experts from relevant fields in intelligent rail industry. In their term reports, the students will have to demonstrate the prototypes of their projects and to be reviewed by the invited senior professionals from rail industry. The prerequisites for taking this course will be determined based on the background of students with different majors.

notes: 機械三四合開

description.zh: 全球化製造體系的形成，使得合約製造商必須以更積極的態度，從策略面出發，藉由各種電腦與網路的技術，整合內部與外部的流程與資訊，打造數位工廠。數位製造的目的，是希望藉由資訊透明化，提升整個製造體系的競爭優勢。課程的設計，是以概念介紹的方式，說明數位製造的應用現況與相關技術。本課程的內容包括：數位製造概論、數位製造實例說明、商業模型分析、企業知識入口網站、產品資料管理、交易系統、資料倉儲、企業資訊入口網站。
description.en: Brief: Globalization has lead contract manufactures more active on seeking new strategies to survive. To increase competition, new technologies, such as computer and network technology, have applied. Computer and network technology can integrate internal and external information to establish a so-called "e-factory." This course covers different issues related to e-Manufacturing, such as Concept of e-Manufacturing, Case Study, Business Model Analysis, Knowledge Management, Enterprise Knowledge Portal (EKP), Product Data Management (PDM), Concept of Trading Systems, Concept of Data Warehousing, Enterprise Information Portal (EIP), Workflow Management, State of the Art Technologies, etc

notes: 機械大四合開

description.zh: 全球化製造體系的形成，使得合約製造商必須以更積極的態度，從策略面出發，藉由各種電腦與網路的技術，整合內部與外部的流程與資訊，打造數位化工廠。數位化製造的目的，是希望藉由資訊透明化，提升整個製造體系的競爭優勢。課程的設計，是以概念介紹的方式，說明數位製造的應用現況與相關技術。本課程的內容包括：數位化製造概論、數位化製造實例說明、商業模型分析、知識管理、企業知識入口網站、產品資料管理、交易系統、資料倉儲、企業資訊入口網站、工作流程管理、最新數位化相關技術介紹。
description.en: Globalization has lead contract manufactures more active on seeking new strategies to survive. To increase competition, new technologies, such as computer and network technology, have applied. Computer and network technology can integrate internal and external information to establish a so-called "e-factory." This course covers different issues related to e-Manufacturing, such as Concept of e-Manufacturing, Case Study, Business Model Analysis, Knowledge Management, Enterprise Knowledge Portal (EKP), Product Data Management (PDM), Concept of Trading Systems, Concept of Data Warehousing, Enterprise Information Portal (EIP), Workflow Management, State of the Art Technologies, etc.

notes: 製科所必選課程之一 / 限 30 人

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。自動化機械設計簡介、自動化機械設計程序、驅動器、感測器、基礎電器控制及電工配線、基礎數位電路設計、氣液壓及電控迴路的邏輯設計法、可程式控制器、監控系統、自動化系統的規劃及評估。
description.en: Automation System Planning & Evaluation, The Process of Automatic Machinery Design, Basic Electric Control & Wiring Basic, Basic Electric Circuit Design, Application of Logic Design method on Pneumatic/ Hydraulic & Electric Circuit, Application of PLC and Industrial Robots, Case Study.

notes: 機械三四合開，先修自動化控制元件或相關基礎.2 週【停開】

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。導論（含系統概論、資料表示法）、微電腦結構－中央處理單元、組合語言－指令型定址法、模組化程式、位元組和字串處裡、I/O 程式、DOS 功能常式、多元程式規劃、系統匯流排結構、I/O 介面、半導體記憶、多元處裡器組態。
description.en: Introduction (Overview of Microprocessor System, Data Representation), Microprocessor Architecture-CPU etc., Assembler Language-Instruction Format, Addressing Modes, Modular Programming, Byte and String Manipulation, I/O Programming, DOS Function Multiprogramming, SystemBus Structure, I/O Interface, Semiconductor Memory, Multiprocessor Configurations.

notes: 機械二和機電二合開，先修數位電路或相關基礎 (須實測)

description.zh: 本課程沿續「積體電路製程先進技術與設備」課程，介紹半導體世代機台開發與製程應用、關鍵元件設計概念與應用，著重科學基礎知識如何應用在半導體產業。
description.en: As an extension of “Processing technology and equipment for advanced semiconductor manufacturing” course, this course focuses on how the scientific knowledge is connected and applied to the real development of tools and introduces the evolution of the design and application of semiconductor tools and key components.

name.zh: 半導體尖端設備與關鍵元件
name.en: Semiconductor advanced equipment and key components

notes: 機電所和製科所合開，上課教室由教務處安排

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意介紹雷射加工之理論及實務，注重製程參數之研究，教導學生如何掌握製程，以達到精密製造的要求。內容包括雷射輔助製造程序、雷射加工設備、雷射加工原理、系統分析、實驗設計、雷射加工實例。
description.en: Introducing theory and practice of laser material processing. Emphasizing the study of manufacturing factors. Letting the students know how to control manufacturing process, and fulfill the demand of precision manufacturing. The course content is : laser assisted manufacturing processes, facilities for laser material processing, the principles of laser material processing, system analysis, examples of laser material processing.

notes: 機電所和製科所合開，限 22 人

description.zh: 先修課程：3001018 或負責教授同意。介紹特殊加工如超音波加工、放電加工、雷射加工、化學蝕刻、電化學加工、電子束加工、高壓水束加工等，及表面處裡技術等，除了說明加工原理外並探討各加工法之技術。
description.en: This course provides an introduction to special material processing methods including ultrasonic machining,  electrical-discharge machining, laser-material processing, chemical machining, electrochemical machining, electron-beam machining, hydrodynamic machining, and surface treatment techniques, In addition to the principles, techniques for the corresponding process will be discussed.

notes: 機械大三合開，限 30 人

description.zh: 先修課程：3002010 或負責教授同意。晶體結構、鋼之變態、相平衡原理、退火與正常化、淬火與回火、表面硬化處理、構造用鋼、工具鋼、其它鋼料及鑄鐵之熱處理。
description.en: The contents of this course can be categorized as followings: 1. fundamental metallographic concepts.2. The effects of alloying elements in steel.3. Hardenability 4. General heat treatment processes: annealing, hardening, tempering, and normalizing. 5. Special heat treatment process : tool steels hardening and tempering. Quenching and tempering of constructional steels, case hardening, nitriding, carbonitriding, induction hardening, and flame hardening.

notes: 機械大四合開，限 15 人

description.zh: 先修課程：3002011 或負責教授同意。基本觀念及其領域、非線性代數之數值解法、聯立方程式之數值解、多項式內外插、微分、積分、常微分方程、起始與邊界值問題之數值解法。
description.en: 1. Introduction to the basic concepts of the numerical method 2. Numerical methods of solving nonlinear algebraic equations. 3. Numerical methods of solving systems of linear equations. 4. Numerical interpolation and extrapolation. 5. Numerical differentiation and integration.6. Numerical methods of ordinary differential equations with initial-value problems and boundary value problems.

notes: 機械大四合開，限 15 人

description.zh: Z - 轉換、取樣資料系統、等效於連續函數的數位濾波器設計、使用轉換技術設計數位控制系統、使用狀態空間設計數位控制系統、電腦控制。
description.en: Z-Transform, Sampled-Data Systems, Discrete Equivalents to Continuous Transfer Functions: The Digital Filter, Design of Digital Control Systems Using Transform Techniques, Design of Digital Control Systems Using State-Space Methods, Application and Practice of Digital Control, Case Study.

notes: 限 50 人

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。使學生瞭解如何由自動控制理論與概念，轉化成控制系統的實務設計與實踐。課程內容包括：機構、致動器、感測器、與控制器等元件及其整合技術介紹，配合 LabView + myRIO 及周邊設備進行控制系統實務設計與測試，使同學由實驗中體會與培養控制系統的實務設計能力。
description.en: The object of the course is to let students understand how to transform the theory and concept of automatic control into a design and practice for a control system. Course contents include: introduction to mechanism, sensors actuator and controller elements, as well as the needed integration technique. LabView + myRIO and peripheral devices are used in the course to design a practically useful controller and to verify its effectiveness. Students therefore can gain the practical controller design experience via this learning by doing approach。

name.en: Design and Practice of  Control System

notes: 機械大三合開

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。類神經網路介紹：演算法，應用，與程式技巧，類神經網路控制器設計與模擬，模糊集合，近似推理理論，模糊邏輯控制器介紹，模糊邏輯控制器設計與模擬，基因演算法介紹，以基因演算法最佳化控制器，智慧型控制應用。
description.en: 1.Introduction to neural network: algorithms, applications, programming techniques. 2. Design and simulation of neural network controller3. Introduction to fuzzy set, approximate reasoning, fuzzy logic controller4. Design and simulation of fuzzy logic controller5. Introduction to genetic algorithm6. Optimization of controller by genetic algorithm7. Applications of intelligent controller

notes: 製科所必選課程之一 / 機電所、製科所和機電博 (含外) 合

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。1. 數位影像基礎，2. 空間域影像強化，3. 頻域影像強化，4. 影像還原，5 彩色影像處理，6 形態學影像處理，7. 影像分割，8. 影像壓縮，9. 機器視覺系統。
description.en: 1. Fundamental digital image, 2. Image enhancement in the spatial domain, 3. Image enhancement in the frequency domain, 4. Image restoration, 5. Color image processing, 6. Morphological image processing, 7. Image segmentation, 8. Image compression. 9. Machine vision system.

notes: 機械大四合開，限 24 人

description.zh: 化學是富挑戰性且具教學難度之科目，使這個複雜的學科讓學生易於接受化學教育家的挑戰，特別是基礎化學。嘗試推展關鍵的化學概念，並以觀察現象為主，再討論理論模式，並用以解釋所觀測的現象是本課程的重點。希望學生實踐 "如同一個化學家的思考方式" 來仔細觀察，而不是跳入公式或模型中。此外，舉例證明化學在現實生活中的重要性與最新的應用及發展並以簡易明瞭的方式呈現於授課內容。
description.en: Chemistry is fascinating and important subject that is challenging to teach and even more challenging to learn. Marking this complex subject accessible to students without distortion is challenge of the chemical educator, especially at the introductory level.In this lecture I try to develop key chemical concept in the same way to show the observations first and then discuss the models that have been constructed to explain the observed behavior. I hope students will practice "thinking like a chemist" by carefully studying the observation to see if they can follow the thought process, rather than just jumping head to the equation or model that will follow.In addition, to demonstrate the importance of chemistry in real life, I have incorporated throughout the book a number of applications and recent advances in essay form.

description.zh: 本課程係以商用繪圖 CAD 軟體（如 Pro-E , Solid Edge 或 AutoCAD 等）為教學範本，內容包括二維製圖，三維製圖，修訂功能表，命令腳本（Script）以及圖組 (Block)、圖形功能表等之製作，以輔助機械製圖為主要目標。
description.en: Use commercial CAD Software (e.g.: Pro-E ,Solid Edge or Auto CAD) as the Tuitional examples for Mechanical Drawings, including 2-D and 3-D drawings, to edit and to modify the Menu, Script and Block etc

notes: 計中電腦教室

description.zh: 幫助學生認識一般科技文章以及科技論文語法、文體、句子結構等，並加強英文口頭表達之能力。
description.en: This course helps the learners recognize the syntax, style, and organization as far as the papers on technology and technical writings are concerned. Discussions include specific ways to technical presentation and technical writings.

notes: 限博士班修習，博士班英文畢業門檻補救課程，限 25 人

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。技術的關鍵特性和技術之生命週期，企業核心技術、來源和取得，技術的管理與風險，國家科技政策之影響，企業與技術生存之道，全球創新產品之開發，全球創新產品的技術策略與戰略，未來趨勢和走向。
description.en: Technological Innovation: Process, Content, and Types, Organization & Organizing for Innovation, Planning and Discontinuous Innovation, Concurrent Engineering and Interface Management, Human Resource Management, Technology Strategy, Dominant Design, Standard, and Compatibility External R&D and Alliances, Competencies and Knowledge Management in R&D Setting, Design and Product Innovation, Global R&D and Product Development, Industrial Research & Development, Assessment and Performance Appraisal, Perspective.

notes: 限 30 人

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。半導體元件簡介、電晶體開關電路、數位積體電路及應用、矽控整流子（SCR）、矽控整流子觸發電路、雙向矽控整流器、運算放大器及應用感測器及應用、電動機驅動電路、變頻器電路。
description.en: Semiconductor Components, Transistor Switch Circuits, Digital ICs and Application, Silicon-Controlled-Rectifier (SCR), Trigger Circuits for SCR, Triac, Operational Amplifier and Application, Sensor and Application, Drivers for Electrical Machines, and Inverters.

notes: 機械大二和機電二合開，限 30 人

description.zh: 專題報告、專題演講、研究小組討論。
description.en: Case Study. Seminar. Group meeting.

notes: 限碩二

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。(1) 雷射器件簡介 (2) 雷射與物質交互作用 (3) 脈衝雷射鍍膜及加工 (4) 雷射光譜學及其應用 (光激螢光譜、拉曼光譜、非線性光譜、時間解析光譜等)。
description.en: Introduction to selected areas of laser applications, including the following topics. (1) Laser principles and instrumentation (2) Interactions between laser light and materials(3) Pulsed laser ablation, deposition, and material processing (4) Laser spectroscopy and the applications (including photoluminescence spectroscopy, Raman spectroscopy, nonlinear spectroscopy, and time-resolved spectroscopy, etc).

description.zh: 利用光纖來製造雷射與光放大器已經廣泛的應用在各領域，由於光纖具有小的纖核，且光在此介質傳播時，通常具有相當長的傳播距離，此外利用各種鎖模技術所產生的短脈衝或是藉由光放大器，使得在光纖中傳播的光具有相當高的功率或是峰值功率，因此許多非線性光學的現象在光纖中被產生，近來更種新穎的光纖包括利用微結構光纖或稱為光子晶體光纖被廣泛的應用，使得光纖所產生非線性效應更為顯著，本課程將介紹在光纖中各種非線性光學現象產生的原理與其應用。
description.en: Fiber laser and amplifier have been widely used in various fields.  Due to  its small core and relative long propagation length of fiber and relative large  power and peak power light source is used, that is generated from mode-locked technique and amplifier, various nonlinear optical phenomena can be observed through propagation of the fiber.  Recently, many novel optical fibers including the microstructured fiber or termed photonic crystal fiber are widely used to cause the advance of the generated nonlinear phenomena.  In this course, it will introduce the principle of the generated nonlinear effects and its applications.

name.zh: 非線性光纖光學與應用

description.zh: (1) 光纖電纜混合系統 (2) 個人通訊系統 (3) 光纖電話系統 (4) 光纖電纜混合電話系統 (5) 有線電視固網 DWDM 系統 (6) 信號間非線性作用 (7) 類比數位通道的干擾 (8) 脈衝雜訊
description.en: (1)Wire Access in HFC Systems (2)Personal Communication Systems (3)Optical Fiber-Based Phone Systems (4)Hybrid-Fiber-Coax BAsed Phone Systems (5)A Hybrid DWDM System for CATC & Fixed Network System (6)Nonlinear Interaction Between Optical Signaals (7)Crosstalk From Analoy Channels to Digital Channel (8)Clipping-Induced Impulse Noise

name.zh: 光纖有線電視固網信號傳輸系統
name.en: Fiber system for CATV, fixed network

description.zh: 藉由國內外設計競賽主題與產學合作設計案進行實際演練，著重於資料蒐集、商品分析、創新構想與成果表達之進階能力養成，期讓學生在國內外設計競賽舞台上展現光芒，在產學合作中習得實務經驗並獲致產業界肯定。因此本課程旨在以實際演練達成兼具創新性與商品化專業設計能力養成。
description.en: Advanced Product Design (I) educates students to identify and resolve design problems - innovatively and with sensitivity to the social, physical and ecological environment.  Students learn to analyze and solve diverse design problems from technical, aesthetic, social and ecological viewpoints. Students are given the resources to identify, expand and test personal and professional development through an intensive exploration of design ideas.  Innovation is stressed, along with the ability to refine formal design issues.  There are numerous opportunities for students to work with industry through corporate-sponsored studio projects and design competitions.

notes: 日職合開

description.zh: 逆向工程已成為電腦輔助產品開發技術重要的一環，透過三次元量測或掃瞄技術，取得工件表面的點資料，據以建構 3D CAD 幾何模型 (Geometric model)，以供後續設計、電腦輔助工程分析 (CAE) 與電腦輔助製造 (CAM) 之應用。逆向工程的程序分為三個階段：(1) 擷取工件表面的點資料；(2) 點資料的前置處理；以及 (3) 建構或更新幾何模型。依此流程，本課程首先講述各類運用於逆向工程中的量測與掃瞄技術，並以設計應用觀點為基礎，討論其間的差異與優缺點，隨著運用領域的不同，而採取不同的量測技術；其次介紹點資料前置處理的理念與方法，從現有文獻中，解析的相關的技術，因量測技術與策略的差異，而發展出不同的處理技術；至於，重建或更新原有的幾何模型的部分，將著重設計實務的應用，並與現有的 CAD 系統整合的策略。課程之目標，為使修習本課程之學生能對逆向工程的相關理論與技術，有全盤的認識與瞭解，並透過實際案例的操作，訓練學生能具備實務作業能力。
description.en: Reverse engineering has become an important tool for geometric model construction in 3D CAD based on the data points, digitized from an existing part, for the downstream applications such as CAE and CAM. The process of reverse engineering can usually be subdivided into three stages, i.e. (1) part digitization for capturing the data points; (2) data point pre-processing; and (3) CAD modeling and/or updating. In this course, the relevant techniques in the three stages of reverse engineering procedure are introduced firstly. Through the project practice, the student is able to adept to the techniques of reverse engineering.

notes: 日職合開

description.zh: ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
description.en: The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

description.zh: 本課程著重教導學生閱讀文章，並藉由文章訓練學生字彙建構、語言解析及聽力會話、思維啟發能力。課中延展活動將閱讀內容與聽力、會話、寫作做進一步的連結，並引導學生將所學做有效的應用。
description.en: The course provides students with explicit skills-based instruction in learning how to process, and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skills development, vocabulary building, language analysis, and thought-provoking discussions. The readings include a variety of viewpoints on global topics centered around social issues, the environment, psychology, business, and technology. Extension activities are designed to encourage students to go beyond the reading text, and to put what they acquire from the readings into listening, speaking and writing practices.

name.zh: 基礎英文閱讀與字彙 (二)
name.en: Basic English Reading and Vocabulary II

notes: 初級

description.zh: 本課程提供學生及職前專業人士必備之英語文語言技巧，強調機電專業領域之英文溝通能力之訓練。課程內容依學院專業內容區分並整合英語文之聽說讀寫之能力為未來全球化移動及以英語專業溝通人才培育為目標。
description.en: This course aims to provide pre-service Mechanical & Electrical Engineering students/professionals with the adequate skills of the English language and communicative competence to facilitate their current academic and future career pursuits. Students are encouraged to utilize their domain expertise to participate in professional communication in English. Centered on the training of professional use of the English language, the ESP curriculum as the crux of a highly-integrated work of domain knowledge and the English learning development embodies the indispensable credentials required for a global profession.

notes: 中級 A

description.zh: 本課程旨在提升學生資訊領域的英語文能力，加強學生於該領域課堂學習與未來職業所需的閱讀與口說技巧。本課程中，學生將經由研讀資訊領域相關文章以及針對相關主題的討論，增加資訊領域的字彙，並加強英語能力與溝通技巧。
description.en: This course is designed for students who are interested in improving English skills in the field of information technology. It aims to increase students’ reading fluency and improve their speaking skills needed to function and succeed in classroom settings and in future career. In this course, authentic reading texts related to information technology will be used. Students will discuss topics, such as artificial intelligence and the World Wide Web, in order to expand vocabulary and language skills.

notes: 中級

description.zh: 本課程教授商業領域知識以及實務應用。修習本課程之學生，將習得中高階英語素養以及商務溝通基本知識。課程內容包含：基礎商業概念、重點時事商業議題、基本商業字彙，和廣泛商業實務用語。
description.en: The course is designed for students who wish to strengthen English competence as well as increase their knowledge in business-related issues and expertise in future business practice. All students enrolled in this course are expected to be equipped with high-intermediate level of English proficiency as well as basic knowledge of effective business communication. This course covers rudimentary business concepts, important current business events, essential business terms, and English use in business practice.

notes: 中級

description.zh: 本課程旨在帶領學生讀、理解並分析國際時事，提高學生之英文能力，透過對多元主體之解析，讓學生了解單字用法，句型結構，特殊術語和慣用俚語等，提升閱讀能力，另外配合聽力技巧學習，提升理解能力。本課程著重英文閱讀，聽力與口說能力，鼓勵學生以英文討論國際時事，發表見解，拓展對世界的認識。
description.en: This course intends to enhance students’ reading, speaking and listening abilities by using quality newspapers, journals, interviews and podcast. It will help students enrich their vocabulary and acquire key English expressions and sentence patterns used in different realms like politics, arts, entertainment, science & technology, sports, business and health. Students learn to read, discuss and debate global issues through diverse forms of activities. This course familiarizes students with world affairs and broadens their perspective of the world.

description.zh: 本課程為學年課程的第二部分，旨在加強學生在科技背景下的英語能力，側重技術領域的真實場景應用。 學生應在各種科技情境及環境中應用基本的英語語言技能、詞彙、結構和科技英語風格。
description.en: This is the second part of the one-year course, aiming to strengthen students’ English competence in the context of technology, highlighting the real-world scenarios in the field of technology. Students are expected to apply basic English language skills, vocabulary, structures and styles of technology English in a variety of technology contexts.

notes: 初級

description.zh: 本課程旨在透過各種英語新聞媒體如電視新聞（如 CNN, BBC, NBC）、英文雜誌（如 The Economist, Scientific American ）、英文報紙（New York Times, Washington Post, the Guardian 等）等，來培養學生的批判性閱讀能力．並同時提升其宏觀視野與多元知識。課堂中將藉由分析英語新聞的用字遣詞、報導角度的取捨、標題與議題的呈現方式等，使學生學習如何思考報導背後之立場，從而進行批判性閱讀。此外，亦將剖析英語新聞中所含括之英美文學典故與文化傳統，帶領學生瞭解新聞英文的豐富意涵。
description.en: This course aims to (1) develop students’ critical reading abilities, (2) expand their global horizons and (3) broaden their knowledge by using diverse English news reports provided by news channels (e.g. CNN, BBC and NBC), news magazines (e.g. The Economist and Scientific American) and newspapers (e.g. New York Times, Washington Post and The Guardian). Students will learn how to read critically by analyzing word choice, reporting angles and the selection and presentation of headlines or quotations. This course will also explore literary allusions and cultural references contained in English news in order to further enhance students’ English language competence.

notes: 高級

description.zh: 本課程目的在提升學生溝通表達能力，並著重於創業思維與專業英文。從專業英語文學習及創業的角度，讓學生了解流程與架構並實際演練，藉此提升學生學習及未來工作所需要之英文能力。
description.en: This course aims to enhance communicative competence with special emphasis on entrepreneurial thinking and professional English skills. From the perspectives of learning English for specific purposes (ESP) and entrepreneurship, students will learn how to create, rehearse and effectively participate in a range of different scenarios for current academic and future career pursuits.

description.en: This course is designed for students to develop business communication skills. description.zh: 本課程介紹了創新的本質、企業創新的原因以及如何管理創新。課程內容程涵蓋有關創新管理的一系列主題，包括創新動機、企業如何利用知識產權（如專利和商標）保護其創新、“研究與開發”（R&D )、創意人員、流程和團隊的管理，產品、服務和體驗創新的管理，“開放式創新” 的採用和使用，以及創新中模塊化的採用和使用。本課程在科技管理的部分主要介紹科技管理廠商層次 (micro-level) 與總體層次 (macro-level) 的相關理論，研究的領域與相關學術期刊。廠商層次介紹開放式創新、創業管理、智慧財產管理、資源論、技術搜尋、產業組織論等。在總體層次介紹科技政策的範疇與相關理論，包括技術典範與軌跡、國家、產業與區域創新系統、服務創新、科技計量與指標與產學合作政策等。課程內容包括以案例研究為重點的討論，其中混合使用虛實的公司來討論管理創新的各個面向。這些討論與課程中涵蓋的主題互補，並以加強用予實際應用的想法。透過本課程，學生可以對碩 / 博士論文的研究課題，能有正確且有效地構建文獻探討的能力。
description.en: This course introduces the nature of innovation, why firms innovate, and how innovation can be managed. This course introduces the micro-level and macro-level of technology management with respect to related theories, research field and academic journal. description.zh: 中文概述 Chinese Description 	(1). 本課程將介紹人工智慧在各種經營管理領域的科技應用，包括：預測分析、客戶關係管理、資源優化、行銷和廣告、智慧客服、決策支援。(2). 學生能夠學到正確學習商業智能與資料科學的 3 個步驟：A. 使用 pandas 模組裡進行商業數據分析與視覺化。B. 用 numpy，sklearn 模組來處理迴歸分析等機器學習問題。C. 用 keras 深度學模組進行商業預測。(3). 本課程將讓著重在培養學生具有基礎的資料科學與數據分析能力，有能力使用 python 來做商業分析與視覺化，精通包括 pandas 與 matplotlib 模組。(4). 訓練學生精通商業數據程式分析，有能力處理資料的一體化分析，包括：數據採集、清洗、查詢與計算、分析與挖掘、可視化。(5). 訓練學生有能力處理採集各種大數據資料，包括：網頁爬取，json，xml，csv, excel，mySQL，noSQL (6). 本課程將探討各種案例，例如『業務銷售分析，淘寶電商數據分析，市場佔有率分析，系所生源分析，股票市場分析，問卷資料分析』。

description.zh: 先修課程：電磁學、工程數學、近代物理。 由電磁學之理論推展光波之運行，並經由近代物理之量子論推導出之原子及分子能階與固態晶體之能帶理論，加以說明電磁波與物質間之作用。介紹共振腔、活化性介質及各種雷射之激發形式等雷射三個基本組成。並針對雷射光之種類、特性及其應用，加以說明。
description.en: Combining the propagation of optical wave been deduced from the electromagnetic theory and the quantum theory introduced by modern physics such as energy level of atom and molecular and the energy band of solid state, the interaction between electromagnetic wave and matter is introduced. The three fundamental components of laser: resonator, active medium, and pumping method are explained. Also the types, characteristics, and applications of various laser are introduced.

description.zh: (1) 生醫與光學基礎 (2) 電子膠囊、內視鏡 (3) 顯微鏡相關 (4) 光學單離 (5) 光學嵌住 (6) 雷射美容治療相關 (7) 光譜分析 (8) 光動力治療、光觸媒法 (9) 光學斷層掃描 (10) 表面電漿子技術 (11) 螢光光電檢測 (12) 生物晶片 (13) 放射線影像
description.en: (1) Basics of bio-optics (2) Optical measurement in Medical engineering(3) Microscopy (4) Micro and nano technology in Laser capture microdissection (5) Laser trapping (6) Laser and skin effects(7) Spectral technology (8) Photodynamic Therapy(PDT) and Photodynamic diagnosis(PDD) (9)Optical Coherence tomography(10) Surface plasmons (11) Fluorescence sensing technology, spectroscopy and pharmacy analysis (12) Biochip Technology(13) Bio-imaging

notes: 選修 (光電三、電資二合開)

description.zh: 本課程將介紹使用於智慧家庭、智慧製造與智慧醫療應用的感測器結構與基本工作原理，包含光學感測原理、半導體感測原理、機械感測原理、化學感測原理、生物感測原理、各種感測器之測量系統及轉換界面電路設計與近期的感測技術基礎科學發展與議題。
description.en: This course introduces the sensor structure and basic working principles used in smart home, smart manufacturing and smart medical applications, including optical sensors, semiconductor sensors, mechanical sensors, electrochemical sensors, biosensors. Moreover, we will discuss various sensor measurement systems, conversion interface circuit design, and recent scientific development."

notes: 光電三四合開

description.zh: 有關建築歷史、理論、批評、構造、營建管理等相關主題討論。
description.en: A theme topic discussion on the field of architecture history, theory, criticism, structure, construction and management, etc.

notes: 日、職建都所與建築四合開

description.zh: 本課程旨在瞭解世界地域文化中，因人、因時、因地制宜的建築生產過程，及其涉入空間行為因時間積累而呈現的特殊環境型態、類型與結構；即在探討地方自然地理環境，如何經由人類行為的涉入，呈現出富鄉土涵構的人文景觀。
description.en: This course is to understand the relations between human, behavior, material and the environment of architecture in the world. And try to introduce the vernacular characters of the World architecture by the discussion of some special architectural themes.

notes: 日職合開

description.zh: 臺灣建築史的發展大約可分成受到漢民族影響的傳統建築，以及日本和西方世界影響的近現代建築，本課程主要探究臺灣近現代建築發展的歷程。本課程係以時間為軸，將台灣近現代建築分為三個主題：(1) 臺灣近現代建築的背景、(2) 臺灣殖民時期、(3) 二次大戰之後的臺灣建築。
description.en: This course mainly discusses the development of modern Taiwanese architecture since the Japanese colonial period. The historical development of Taiwanese architecture could be divided into traditional Han architecture and modern architecture with Japanese and western influences. Based on the timeline, three themes will be introduced: (1) the background of Taiwanese modern architecture, (2) Taiwanese architecture during the colonial period, (3) Taiwanese architecture after the Second World War.

notes: 建都所與建築四合開

description.zh: 有關建築歷史、理論、批評、構造、營建管理等相關主題討論。
description.en: A theme topic discussion on the field of architecture history, theory, criticism, structure, construction and management, etc.

notes: 日、職建都所與建築四合開

description.zh: 本課程預計透過專題式學習與案例分析調研，帶領學生盤點社區議題並研擬對策，建構城鄉空間的形成與社會族群的關係，並進行城鄉空間再造的提案。
description.en: This course is aimed to involve the students into the project of University Social Responsibility. By means of inventory on issues in communities and through project-based learning, this course will provide students an opportunity to understand the relationship between formation of urban spaces and social groups, then to draft a social plan, a facility plan or even a strategic guidance for further execution. From urban space reconstruction to place-making (regional revitalization), the students are expected to explore the diverse values of architectural profession and to practice the social responsibility by applying their expertise to solve real-world problems.

notes: 配合 USR 計畫

description.zh: 本課程論述工業生產演進與全球綠色設計方法、趨勢，以及規範與法規需求，定義出創新、高品質和優秀的設計。引導學生多元領域學習，在建築設計中提出兼具環境、社會與經濟平衡之構想，藉以奠定我國未來勞動力市場的循環建築創新能量。
description.en: This course discusses the evolution of industrial production and global green design methods and trends, as well as the requirements of regulations and regulations, and defines innovation, high quality and excellent design. Guide students to study in multiple fields, and put forward the concept of environmental, social and economic balance in architectural design, so as to lay the energy of circular architectural innovation in China's future labor market.

description.zh: 本課程包含 ERP 系統演進，全球運籌管理，ERP 系統軟硬體結構，及企業管理智慧系統。
description.en: This course includes: ERP development history, global logistic strategy, ERP software and hardware infrastructures, and enterprise management intelligence system.

notes: 工管四甲乙丙合開限管理學院學生

description.zh: 目前建築工程營建產業多賴以圖文資料溝通，文件易有失誤，會提高成本、工期延長、甚至於爭議之狀況。BIM 工具之運用，可有效提升營建產業生產力。各國政府已紛紛推出 BIM 的審照制度，我國近年來於公共工程招標已要求 BIM 技術之整合運用。本課程針對 BIM 運用於建築生命週期中各產業間的介紹及效益、實例分享，並於課程中指導同學針對 BIM 軟體基礎工具使用。
description.en: Architectural engineering construction industry on which 2D graphic data communication, the file is easy to form mistakes, will increase the cost of the extension of time, even controversial situation. The use of Building Information Modeling (BIM) software tools, which can effectively enhance the productivity of the construction industry. Governments around the world have now launched the BIM audit system.In recent years, Taiwan has asked the public works bidding integrate and use of BIM technology. This course focuses on the introduction and effective life cycle of BIM for architectural industry, examples of sharing.  Guidance to students in courses based tool for BIM software.

name.zh: BIM 建築資訊系統概論

notes: 系上電腦教室

description.zh: 針對大學所習之廣義生產管理再作深入的闡述，一方面做公開的個案分析研討，以收進一步的學習之效，同時要求學生做實務專題研究
description.en: Production and operation management,case study and analysis,and independent study.

description.zh: 為增強 ESL/EFL 學生的整體的語文能力與跨文化溝通的軟實力，流傳各國的有名故事可採用來作為學生研讀、討論與從事再次創造的素材。這些故事包括人們鍾愛幾世紀的老故事，它們後來幾世代的版本，現代的改寫，與時尚的扭曲變種。依照不同主題被歸納成組 (例如：灰姑娘情結，哀怨邪惡的後母，攀龍附鳳的赤貧男子等等) 並以多媒體教學方法，藉由閱讀跨文化與跨世代的故事裡強化英語的教與學。
description.en: In both ESL and EFL classrooms, English serves not only as a means to conduct daily communication but also as a media to explore diversified subjects and fields. To build up students’ communicative competence, famous stories and popular tales prove to be resourceful because of their richness in linguistic, cultural, and psychological significance. In this course, multi-cultural stories (including archetypal tales, classic fairy tales, their modern counterparts, and their twisted revisions) are carefully selected and organized according to their main theme. For future teachers taking this course, the instructor will demonstrate how this approach can be actually practiced to best benefit ESL/EFL students. In the practicum section, future teachers are required to try their hands in using these stories.

name.zh: 文化故事與英語教學應用
name.en: Using Cultural Stories in ESL/EFL Classrooms

description.zh: 探討各種電機特性及工作原理，內容包含：(1) 磁路分析 (2) 電機 - 機械能量轉換 (3) 繞組及氣隙磁動勢 (4) 繞組電感及電壓方程式 (5) 繞組因數 (6) 直流機 (7) 感應機 (8) 同步機。
description.en: Course Title:Electric MachineryDescription:Principles, Construction and Application of transformer,DC motors, DC generators, induction motors, induction generators,synchronous motors and synchronous generators.

notes: 綜科 216B，專簽外加

description.zh: 課程介紹雲端資訊計算與運用相關技術，使學生對雲端平台、架構、服務、程式設計有一全面性瞭解。課程內容包括： 1. 雲端儲存系統架構、儲存網路與虛擬化技術， 2. 業務持續運作儲存技術，3. 儲存架構安全與管理 ，4. 雲端排程技術、效能與安全，5. 虛擬化資料中心建置 - 虛擬計算、儲存、網路、桌面與應用，6. 雲端服務與管理，7. 雲端運算發展概論與企業應用，8. 大量資料運算及案例分析，9.Hadoop 與 Mapreduce，10. 雲端運算之 SaaS 架構，11. 實習課程與專題計畫。
description.en: This course focuses on information storage management, infrastructure, service management, security, and migration strategy for Cloud computing as well as the practice of cloud application through readings, lectures, and class projects. Course topics include: 1. Storage Networking Technologies and Virtualization, 2. Business Continuity, 3. Storage Security and Management, 4. Cloud Scheduling, Performance and Security, 5. Virtualized Data Center building blocks - Virtual Compute, Storage, Network, Desktop, and Application, 6. Cloud Services and Management, 7. Cloud Computing Overview and Business Application, 8. Big Data Computing and Case Study, 9. Hadoop and Mapreduce, 10. Cloud SaaS, 11. Lab. and Final Project.

notes: 一般教室，專簽外加

description.zh: 本課程引入程式設計的觀念與方法，程式設計語言以 C 語言為基礎，於熟習基本程式語法後，再導入 C++ 程式語言。內容著重邏輯思考與程式設計能力之訓練，同時輔以程式設計過程所應注意之程式結構、偵錯、可攜性、軟體工程的基本概念，使修習者得以奠定程式設計之基礎。
description.en: This course introduces to the students the basic computer programming concepts. Syntax and semantics of the C and C++ programming languages will be introduced. Topics cover the methods for analyzing problem statements, designing computer solutions, effective methods of program design using structured programming notions of sequence, selection, and iteration structures.

notes: 能源一、二合開；計中電腦教室

description.zh: 電腦模擬是解決現今工程問題不可或缺之工具，但常用的商業模擬軟體不但價格昂貴，其功能常不足以應付前瞻研究所需。本課程旨在培養學生設計專業領域之模擬程式與分析工具的能力，強化軟體開發工程實務的素養。課程訓練分兩階段進行：第一階段確認學生具備基本程式設計能力。首先使其熟悉 Linux 平台及開源軟體的使用，運行不須理論基礎的簡易粒子模擬，針對收集到的數據進行統計分析，資料視覺化，資料定量分析及洞察等任務。以任務導向的學習方式，刺激同學針對特定問題和需求而快速擬定演算法，系統性地解決問題。第二階段將模擬工具開發的能力應用在各科系的專業上。在進行短暫的文獻回顧後，與修課學生討論其專業領域中可用模擬解決或加速的學術研究及產業問題。針對主題制定計畫內容後，以選定的程式語言撰寫相關的應用程式，並以開發成開源軟體為最終目標。註一、課程函授上以 GNU Fortran 和 Python3 為主要程式語言選擇，但學生可自由選擇所熟悉的語言作為工具。註二、修課基本條件為修畢工程學院各系一年級程式設計相關之基礎課程，且具基本撰寫程式的能力。
description.en: This course aims to provide complete training for developing modeling and simulation tools in engineering applications. Students will obtain the ability to analyze problems, formulate algorithms, write code, and implement the developed open-source programs in their fields of study. The first part of the training focuses on task-oriented coding experiences. Students will get familiar with the Linux platform and open-source programs. They will perform simple, particle-based simulations. The collected data will be analyzed, visualized, and interpreted based on the programs written by students.The second part of the training applies the coding knowledge to students’ fields of study. After the literature survey, students will select the topic based on theirexpertise, where research or industrial problems can be accelerated by computer modeling. The final goal is to create software based on the course project.

name.en: Development of Simulation Tools  for Engineering

notes: 大研合開，計中電腦教室

description.zh: 數據無處不在。隨著真實世界和數位世界交互影響，越來越多的設計決策有望得到數據分析的支持。本課程旨在培養設計師的數據素養技能。首先介紹對個性化產品和服務的需求，是如何從認知及情感面來創造更好的使用者經驗，並將數據資訊轉換為產品知識 / 服務設計 / 系統決策。大部分課堂時間將以研究導向的設計專題方式進行。完成本課程後，您將能夠：1. 區分批量生產及個性化設計 2. 了解如何將數據科學納入設計流程 3. 描述由不同來源（例如人類、機器或環境）生成的數據特徵和形式 4. 應用合適的工具 / 軟體來解釋小型或大型數據集 5. 了解在設計過程中使用數據的倫理與關鍵原則
description.en: Data is everywhere. As the physical and digital worlds have become intertwined, more and more design decisions are expected to be supported by data analytics. Hence, this course aims to build your data literacy skills as a designer. The course will begin by introducing the need for personalized products and services to create a better user experience.
