description.zh: 設計與生活是自古以來就相生相隨的一項行為，生活型態的變化，對生活器具的要求也就不同。故本課程主要在探討研究設計行為與生活型態之關係，進而提供新思維作為設計行為之參考。
description.en: Design is a part of human life. Demands in design changes with lifestyle. This course focuses on general review of lifestyle research that is practically constructive in the process of product planning and design.

notes: 工設二三四和創新所合開；新聘老師

description.zh: 先修課程：3002010 或負責教授同意。鑄造用材料、鑄鐵、鑄鋼及非鐵金屬之鑄造、鑄造品之熱處理、特殊鑄造程序及方法。
description.en: Pattern, Molding Processes and Materials, Molding Processes, Cores, Solidification of Metals, Principles of Metallurgy,  Gating Systems Pouring, Materials for Foundry Engineering,  Casting Steel and Non-metals, Heat treatment of Casting Works, Special Casting Processes and Methods etc.

notes: 1 週【停開】

description.zh: 設計科學研究重視創造與解決現實世界問題相關且實用的成品或服務。目標是開發具有實用價值並可在實務中實施的解決方案或進一步進行設計驗證。課堂進行方式，除了方法講解，將於課堂採用方法卡與結構化的課堂互動模式，深化學生對設計學在學術研究方法的認識與應用。學生將學會：1. 理解設計學的範疇與趨勢 2. 理解如何擬定研究命題與設計研究方法 3. 理解量化與質性研究方法 4. 理解研究結果的詮釋與視覺化 5. 擬定研究命題、研究框架、研究流程與方法
description.en: Design science research values the creation of finished products or service that are relevant and useful in solving real-world problems. The goal is to develop solutions that have practical value and can be implemented in practice or for further design verification. In addition to method explanations, method cards and a structured classroom interaction mode will be used in class to deepen students' understanding and application of design methods in academic research. Students will learn:1.Understand the scope and trends of design2.Understand how to formulate research propositions and design research methods3.Understand quantitative and qualitative research methods4.Understand the interpretation and visualization of research results5.Formulate research propositions, research framework, research processes and methods

name.zh: 設計學研究方法與實踐策略
name.en: Design Science Research Methods & Practical Strategies

notes: 新聘老師

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹河川污染控制中有關河川污染源的種類及數量，就其分析模式中有關溶氧之來源、溶氧之消耗、非感潮河川與氧垂曲線模式之推演、河川調查及資料分析工作及河川涵容能力之計算方法亦有完整之敘說，藉由河川涵容能力之推估，達到控制或分配家庭污水及工業廢水之目的。
description.en: The objective of this course is to introduce the River Pollution Control.

notes: 土木三四甲乙合開 / 限 40 人

description.zh: 操作化學相關的實驗
description.en: It covers the fundamental experiments in chemistry.

description.zh: 結晶學已經是成為當今科學研究領域的一門重要知識與技術。至目前為止至少有 20 位諾貝爾獎得主其貢獻都與結晶學有關。在這課程，我們將闡述結晶學的相關基本知識，例如：晶格、對稱、原子散射、結構因子及解結構。此外，這門課程也將涵蓋實際操作解結構。所有基礎知識與實作，涵蓋單晶繞射與粉末繞射。也將涵蓋部分蛋白質結晶學的基本知識。
description.en: Crystallography has become an important field in scientific knowledge and technique in physics, chemistry, materials, and biology, which has been recognized by more than 20 winners of Nobel prize. In this course, we will illustrate the fundamental knowledge about crystal lattice, symmetry, atomic scattering, structure factor, and structure determination. In addition, the course also includes practices in structure determination by single crystal x-ray diffraction and powder x-ray diffraction. All fundamental knowledge and practices are mainly in small molecular cases, but part of knowledge of protein crystallography will also be included.

notes: 限制 13 人分子四和高分所合開

description.zh: 結晶學已經是成為當今科學研究領域的一門重要知識與技術。至目前為止至少有 20 位諾貝爾獎得主其貢獻都與結晶學有關。在這課程，我們將闡述結晶學的相關基本知識，例如：晶格、對稱、原子散射、結構因子及解結構。此外，這門課程也將涵蓋實際操作解結構。所有基礎知識與實作，涵蓋單晶繞射與粉末繞射。也將涵蓋部分蛋白質結晶學的基本知識。
description.en: Crystallography has become an important field in scientific knowledge and technique in physics, chemistry, materials, and biology, which has been recognized by more than 20 winners of Nobel prize. In this course, we will illustrate the fundamental knowledge about crystal lattice, symmetry, atomic scattering, structure factor, and structure determination. In addition, the course also includes practices in structure determination by single crystal x-ray diffraction and powder x-ray diffraction. All fundamental knowledge and practices are mainly in small molecular cases, but part of knowledge of protein crystallography will also be included.

notes: 限制 7 人分子四和高分所合開

description.zh: 固態化學是一門涵蓋物理、化學、與材料的跨領域科學。在此課程，我們將講述如何應用化學的知識與概念來了解固態材料，這包含晶體結構，化學鍵結、繞射、光譜、與熱分析技術。此外，我們也將用物理化學的觀念，來討論固態材料的光、電與磁的特性。
description.en: Solid state chemistry is a multidisciplinary filed which covers the physics, chemistry and material science. In this course, we will illustrate how to use chemistry knowledge to approach the solid state materials, which includes the crystal structure, chemical bonding, diffraction techniques, spectroscopy, and thermal analysis. Moreover, the electrical, magnetic and optical properties of solid state materials will also be discussed by the point of view of physical chemistry.

description.zh: 本門授課之目的在於介紹奈米材料及其製程 (包括濕式及乾式奈米材料法)，並探討奈米材料的未來發展及應用。所包括的課程主題如下：1. 奈米材料與奈米化學簡介。2. 奈米材料與結構分析 3. 奈米材料製成 4. 奈米材料自我組成 5. 奈米材料模擬 6. 碳奈米微管 7. 中孔洞奈米晶體之合成 8. 半導體奈米粒之製備與應用 9. 奈米材料的遠景與未來發展
description.en: The course introduces nanomaterials and their preparation processes (wet method and dry method).  The future development and applications are also discussed.This course will cover the following topics:1.	Introduction of nanomaterials and nanochemistry2.	Nanomaterials:  structure and analysis3.	Nanomaterials:  processing4.	Nanomaterials:  self-assembly5.	Nanomaterials:  simulation6.	Carbon nanotubes7.	Synthesis and sintering of mesoporous nanocrystals8.	Growth and application of semiconductor nanoparticlesProspective vision of nanomaterials

description.zh: 對各種材料（金屬、陶瓷、高分子、複合材料）之基本原理，性質及應用，做概要性的介紹。內容包括材料之晶體結構與晶體缺陷，固體材料之原子擴散，相圖與相變化，材料製程及應用，材料之物理性質（光性質、電性質、磁性質及熱性質）.
description.en: Special topics in 1.The structure of crystalline solids. 2.Imperfections in solids. 3.Phase transformation and phase equilibrium. 4.Strengthening mechanism of materials. 5.Metal alloys 6.Ceramics 7.Polymers

name.en: Special Topics of Materials Science and Engineering

description.zh: 本課程係探討纖維製品在非衣著終端領域之應用，例如電子電機，土木，材料，生醫，航空與車輛工程等之應用。其內容包括功能性與機能性纖維、複合紗、複合織物、編帶、非織物、纖維系複合材料與電線電纜、光纖電纜等之製造方法、原理與其終端應用領域。最後將討論微細加工技術與微細粉末在纖維與高科技工業上之應用。
description.en: The course is to interpret the application of the non-apparel textiles at the different end uses, such as application in electrical and electronic, civil, material, biomedical, aerospace, and vehicle engineering etc.  It includes fabrication methods, principles, and end application fields of the performance and functional fibers, composite yarns, composite fabrics, braid, nonwoven, textile composites, and cables and optical cables etc.　Finally, the micro processing technology and powder in textile and high-tech industries will be discussed.

notes: 分子三四合開、限制 30 人

description.zh: 以纖維材料與複合材料的知識為基礎，實際應用於纖維系複合材料實習；並利用各種現有之機械與電氣性質檢測儀器，對其性能加以評估。其實習內容包括熱可塑與熱固性樹脂之製備；單軸向、雙軸向與三軸向複合材料之加工等之實習；及複合材料機械與電氣性質等之實習。
description.en: On the basis of knowledge from the fiber and composites, various experiments are carried out.  Different measuring instruments are also used to measure and evaluate their mechanical and electrical properties.  The practice includes thermoplastic and thermosetting resin preparation, fiber prepreg preparation, 1-D, 2-D, and 3-D composites processing methods are included. Such as filament winding, hand lay-up, molding compounds, autoclave and vacuum bag method, injection molding, compression molding, SMC, and BMC, pultrusion etc. Otherwise, the mechanical and electrical properties of the composites are also studied.

notes: 分子三四合開、限制 30 人

description.zh: 高分子流變學本課程以講述高分子流體之黏性及彈性為主。內容包括：(1) 黏彈性簡介 (2) 時間溫度轉換 (3) 非結晶區之玻璃轉移點 (4) 橡膠理論 (5) 黏彈模型 (6) 介電鬆弛等專題。
description.en: This course will extensively study the viscosity and elasticity of polymeric materials. The main contents include(1) Phenomenalogical Treatment of Viscoelasticity(2) Time-Temperature Correspondence(3) Transitions and Relaxation in Amorphous Polymers(4) Rubber Elasticity(5) Viscoelastic Models(6) Dielectric Relaxation

description.zh: 1. 醫用電子學之基礎。2. 生醫電物理化學之基礎。3. 人體生理系統與經絡系統介紹。4. 生醫系統電物理化學模型分析。5. 醫用電探針、感測器元件與生物晶片的應用。6. 量測理論與生醫電訊號量測技術。7. 生醫電訊號處理技術。8. 超音波、紅外線、X 光、CT、磁振醫學造影原理與影像處理。9. 醫用電子安全規格製訂。10. 醫用醫療儀器與生化分析儀設計。11.DICOM、HL7 醫療網路資訊系統介紹。12. 中西醫工應用系列介紹。
description.en: 1.Fundamental of medical electronics。2.Fundamental of electro-physiology。3.Introduction to human body system and Meridian system。4.Electronic physics-chemical modeling analysis of   biomedical system。5.Applications of medical electrode、biosensor and biochip。 6.Medical measurement theory and technology。7.Processing technology of biomedical signals。8.Constructing and processing of ultrasound、infrared、X-ray  、CT and MRI Imaging。9.Safety specifications of medical electronic devices。10.Designs of biomed

notes: 機電所和機械自動化外生班合開，限 50 人

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意本課程介紹有限元素分析法基本原理及其在各種工程問題上之應用。1. 有限元素分析法之基本觀念 2. 利用變分原理建立有限元素模式 3. 形狀函數及等參數元素 4. 一維問題：桿、桁架、樑及骨架等 5. 二維問題：平面應力應變及板殼問題。6. 三維問題：一般實體 7. 有限元素分析之計算機程式處理 8. 有限元素分析於動態問題之應用 9. 相關有限元素分析套裝軟體簡介
description.en: To introduce the basic principle of the finite element analysis and its application in solving various types of engineering problems.1. Introduction to the basic concepts of the finite element analysis2. Formulation of the finite models through the use of variational principles3. Shape functions and isoparametric elements4. One dimensional problems: rod, truss, beam, frame, etc.5. Two dimensional problems: plane stress, plane strain and plate, etc.6. Three dimensional problems: typical solids7. Implementation of the FEM computation by computer8. Finite element applications in dynamic problems9. Survey of some finite-element software systems

notes: 製科所必選課程之一 / 製科所、機械自動化外和機電博 (含

description.zh: 認識通俗科技文章及科技學術論文語法、文體、結構組織等特質，並探討技術報告及論文撰寫方式。
description.en: This course helps the learners recognize the syntax, style, and organization as far as the papers on technology and technical writings are concerned. Discussions include specific ways to technical presentation and technical writings.

notes: 401, 博班必修，碩士不計學分，面談加簽 (附英檢未過證明

description.zh: 工業 4.0 智能工廠因為大量使用電腦資訊流進行智慧控制達到產線無人化境地，雲端資料庫技術是智能工廠的核心技術，從智慧排單到網頁控制，達到智能聯網與控制。
description.en: The industry 4.0 intelligent factory uses large amount of information to reach intelligent control without people. Cloud database technology is the core of an intelligent factory, which can reach the intelligent network and control from intelligent production order to website control.

notes: 機電所和製科所合開，限 10 人

description.zh: 先修課程：動態分析與模擬或負責教授同意。  非線性系統現象介紹，參數影響及應用模擬方法，數值分析及案例研究。
description.en: Nonlinear phenomena, Effects of parameters, Simulations and analyses, Case study.

notes: 機電所、製科所、自動化所和機電博 (含外) 合開，限 20 人

description.zh: 使用 partakar  code ，Ansys ， Mold  flow ， C  Mold ， Phoneic  等其中軟體，來計算一維穩態，一維暫態，二維穩態，二維暫態，之熱傳導問題，邊界層之偶合性流場問題，燃燒場之數值計算，電子熱傳相關系統。
description.en: By using software of Partankar Code, Ansys, Mold flow, C mold, and Phoneics parckage to compute the one dimension steady, are dimension unsteady, two dimension steady , two dimension unsteady heat conduction problems, boundary layer compling flow's problems,combustion calculations, electronic heat transfer problems.

notes: 機電所和製科所合開，限 24 人，配合 USR 計畫

description.zh: 本課程主要介紹奈米結構材料之合成及其製程技術。內容大綱包括三部分：第一、奈米材料基本物理與化學特性，第二、奈米粉末和薄膜結構材料之化學合成，物理合成製程原理與特性，奈米塊體材料的性能與製備，第三、奈米結構材料應用。
description.en: This course is divided into three sections. The first four chapters deal with those chapters which are the principles of nanostructured Material. The next two chapters describe the engineering options currently available for the synthesis, processing and fabrication of nanostructured materials. The last two chapters deal with different application of nanostructured materials.

notes: 製科所必選課程之一 / 機電所和製科所合開，限 60 人

description.zh: 本課程介紹當前針對訊號及影像常用之辨識演算法，包括支持向量機、支持向量描述、主成分分析、非線性主成分分析、線性鑑別分析、自回歸模型、共同空間圖形濾波。
description.en: Topics include support vector machine (SVM), support vector data description (SVDD), principal component analysis (PCA), nonlinear PCA, linear discriminant analysis (LDA), autoregressive model, and common spatial

notes: 機電所、製科所、機械自動化專班和機電博 (含外) 合開，

description.zh: 機械手臂基礎理論，內容包含座標轉換、機械臂運動學、反運動學、動力學、軌跡規畫、機械臂設計、機械臂控制、機械臂的程式語言等。
description.en: It is a fundamental course concerning the theories of robotic manipulators. Topics contain frame transformations, manipulator kinematics, inverse kinematics, dynamics, trajectory planning, manipulator design, control of manipulators, robot programming languages.

notes: 機電所、製科所、機械自動化專班和機電博 (含外) 合開，

description.zh: 彈性力學為固體力學的重要分支，研究彈性物體在外力和其他外界因素（包括外力、溫度、電磁場等）作用下產生的變形和內力。彈性力學廣泛應用於建築、機械、化工、航太等工程領域，是學習有限元素法、複合材料力學、破裂力學和疲勞等的基礎課程，對於培養學生的專業基礎，思維方法和獨立工作能力有著重要意義。
description.en: Elasticity is a branch of Solid mechanics that deals with determination of the stress, strain, and displacement distribution in an elastic solid under the influence of external forces. This subject has applications in many engineering and scientific fields such as civil engineering, mechanical engineering, materials engineering, and aeronautical and aerospace engineering. The subject also provides the basis for more advanced work in finite element analysis, mechanics of composite materials, fracture mechanics.

notes: 製科所和機械自動化外生班和機電博 (含外) 合開，限 15 人

description.zh: 本課程以介紹電腦在工程設計應用為主，內容有電腦輔助繪圖含電腦三維實體模型建立、電腦模擬、最佳設計、有限元素分析等。
description.en: This course introduces the computer aided engineering techniques applied in mechanical engineering design. The course contents will include topics on computer aided design and draft including the creation of 3D solid model, computer simulation, Optimization technique, and finite element analysis techniques

notes: 機電所、製科所、機械自動化專班和機電博 (含外) 合開，

description.zh: 先修課程：半導體元件物理﹙4005032﹚。本課程著重於 IC 製程技術之學習。課程內容包括：IC 絕緣技術、模組製程技術、導線技術、整合工程技術、SOC 技術及半導體奈米元件技術等。
description.en: A study on advanced IC process. The contents cover IC isolation technology, module process, interconnection line process, process integration, SOC applications and CMOS nano device engineering etc.

notes: 機電所、製科所、機械自動化專班和機電博 (含外) 合開，

description.zh: 顆粒物質充斥在日常生活且廣泛應用在許多工業問題中，例如筒倉、流體化床以及積層製造等等。本概論式課程將提供學生顆粒物質流的基礎概念以及模擬方法，並對其實際應用問題能有更深入的了解。課程將從顆粒物質的基本流動特性開始介紹，進而介紹顆粒物質流的離散模擬方法。此課程最後一部分將實際展示在工程上以及工業上所遇到的顆粒物質流問題。
description.en: Granular materials are ubiquitous in our daily lives and have attracted growing interest in many industrial applications, such as silo storage, fluidized bed, additive manufacturing, etc. This course is an introductory course to provide the general concepts and simulation methods of granular material flows, and a comprehensive understanding for its applications. The course will start from the basic flow characteristics of granular materials, and then move to the discrete simulation approaches. The final part of this course will demonstrate the practical engineering and industrial problems of granular material flows.

notes: 機電所、製科所、機械自動化專班和機電博 (含外) 合開，

description.zh: 本課程之目標為依人力職能需求，參考國內外之先行經驗，整合智能化生產所需之知識與技能訓練，以淬鍊出一套務實之智能化生產課程。本課程將涵蓋工業 4.0 - 智能化生產所需相關基礎技術之教學與實作課程，包括物聯網基礎技術與應用實例、雲端服務系統與資訊安全技術、巨量資料管理、分析、及應用實例、智慧化企業與工廠管理系統與應用、自動化與機器人技術及應用等等。
description.en: The goal of this course is to meet the needs of the manpower function, with reference to the previous experiences from domestic and abroad groups. This course will cover the topics related to the basic technology required for intelligent production, including the basic technology and application examples of the Internet of Things, the cloud service system and information security technology, the huge amount of data management, Intelligent enterprise and factory management systems and applications, automation and robot technology and applications, and so on.

notes: 製科所必選課程之一 / 機電所、製科所、機械自動化外和

description.zh: 銲接冶金課程深入研究金屬銲接技術與冶金過程，培養學生在材料處理和銲接技術方面的專業能力。課程包括銲接方法、銲材選擇、熱影響、金屬結構與性能及銲接缺陷等內容，並結合實際案例，使學生能理解並應用於工程實務。
description.en: The welding metallurgy course in the graduate program delves into metal welding techniques and metallurgical processes, cultivating students' expertise in material handling and welding technologies. The curriculum covers welding methods, selection of welding materials, heat-affected zones, metal structures and properties, welding defects, and incorporates real-world cases to enable students to comprehend and apply them in engineering practice.

notes: 機電所、製科所、機械自動化專班和機電博 (含外) 合開，

description.zh: 課程目標在於教授 CG 軟體於多媒體產業上的應用， 並使學生具備建置素材庫 (Game-Ready Models) 之能力。透過專案式教學，讓學生了解建模、材質、綁定、渲染的進階應用及銜接遊戲引擎的工作流程，並搭配 Unity Animator、UML、C#， 去完善模型素材在遊戲引擎中的控制呈現，讓學生具備銜接設計端與程式端的技術，並為後續客製化虛擬實境應用的素材做出準備。  CG 軟體教學將著重在視覺化程式工具的使用，讓學生利用程式思維、節點編程加速專案的進行；程式教學部分將使用 Unity Animator、C# 以完成遊戲 Assets 的設置。最終評量將以期末的專案呈現為主要評分方式。
description.en: The course objective is to teach the application of CG software in the multimedia industry and equip students with the ability to build a material library (Game-Ready Models). Through project-based learning, students will understand advanced modeling, texturing, rigging, rendering, and the workflow of integrating with game engines. Together with Unity Animator, UML, and C#, they will refine the control and presentation of model materials in game engines, enabling students to connect design and programming skills and prepare for customizing virtual reality applications.The CG software instruction will focus on the use of visual programming tools, enabling students to accelerate project progress using programming thinking and node programming. The programming instruction will use Unity Animator and C# to configure game assets. The final assessment will primarily be based on the presentation of the end-of-term project.

notes: 限 40 人，先修電腦輔助設計一、二

description.zh: 智慧製造意旨透過資通訊及數位技術（例如數位控制、智慧機器人、自動光學檢測、雲端運算、人工智慧與物聯網等）的輔助，讓生產系統更具智慧，減少生產成本、提升產品品質與增加客戶滿意。本課程透過問題導向學習 (PBL) 方法，引導學生學習關於智慧製造之核心技術。
description.en: English description：The objective of smart manufacturing is to reduce manufacturing cost using information and communication technology, including digital control, industrial Robotics, automated inspection, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and internet of thing (IOT). This course provides introduction of smart manufacturing and hands on practice about collaborative robot (Cobot) and manufacturing execution system (MES) operation under the framework of problem-based learning (PBL) model.

name.zh: 智慧製造 PBL 專題
name.en: Problem Based Learning, special topics in Smart Manufacturing

notes: 工管四甲乙丙 碩合開 限管理學院學生

description.zh: 本課程涵蓋了基於各種檢測模式 (如化學修飾、電化學、光學與半導體科技) 的化學與生醫感測器的基礎知識以及利用電子元件感測生理訊號。 主題包括感測原理、常見的化學感測器、生物感測器、選擇策略、元件設計以及醫療保健、環境監測和工業等領域的應用。課程安排除了感測器文獻之相關課堂討論之外，也會安排學者講座。學生參加所有講座和參加課堂討論是課程的必修部分。
description.en: This course covers the fundamentals of chemical sensors and biosensors based on chemical modifications, electrochemistry, spectroscopy, semiconductor technologies, and physiological electrical signal measurements. Topics include sensing principles, commonly used sensors, strategies for achieving selectivity and adequate limits of detection, design of devices, and applications in health care, environmental monitoring, industry, and military areas. Articles from the current literature are discussed. We will also invite researchers to introduce current research. Active student participation is expected as an integral part of the course.

notes: 請安排 PBL 教室；網路預選限 25 人 (研究所)；大

description.zh: 本課程涵蓋了基於各種檢測模式 (如化學修飾、電化學、光學與半導體科技) 的化學與生醫感測器的基礎知識以及利用電子元件感測生理訊號。 主題包括感測原理、常見的化學感測器、生物感測器、選擇策略、元件設計以及醫療保健、環境監測和工業等領域的應用。課程安排除了感測器文獻之相關課堂討論之外，也會安排學者講座。學生參加所有講座和參加課堂討論是課程的必修部分。
description.en: This course covers the fundamentals of chemical sensors and biosensors based on chemical modifications, electrochemistry, spectroscopy, semiconductor technologies, and physiological electrical signal measurements. Topics include sensing principles, commonly used sensors, strategies for achieving selectivity and adequate limits of detection, design of devices, and applications in health care, environmental monitoring, industry, and military areas. Articles from the current literature are discussed. We will also invite researchers to introduce current research. Active student participation is expected as an integral part of the course.

notes: 請安排 PBL 教室；網路預選限 25 人 (大學部)；大

description.zh: 本課程介紹複合材料的原理，包括複合材料的高分子化學、複合材料的加工方法、複合材料的力學分析與設計、以及複合材料在高科技上的應用。加工方法包括真空袋成型法、壓力釜成形法、樹脂移送成型、編織法、纏繞成形法、拉擠成型法、模壓法… 等，本課程詳述這些加工方法的原理及應用，同時介紹力學分析及設計，應力和應變之關係，複材之彎曲、靜態和動態之強度、脫層、耐久性、及以力學觀點設計複合材料，最後討論複合材料如何應用於高科技及民生工業上。
description.en: This course is to elucidate the principle and potential application of composite materials. It includes polymer chemistry, design and analysis of composite, and processing methods. The composite processings include autoclaves,vacuum vags, resin transform molding, braiding, filament winding, pultrusions, sheet molding compound,…etc. The principles and application of the methods will be elucidated. The analysis and design, strain-stress relationships, extension and bending, static and dynamic strengths, and delamination, will also be discussed. Finally, the potential application of the composite in high-tech industries will be elucidated.

notes: 新聘老師

description.zh: 每天許多人規律運動、觀賞及討論賽事，若具備暢談體育以及運動相關俚語的英文能力，將十分有益於與英語人士交流。本課程將介紹學生適用於體育以及其他社交場合的英語單字（包含許多用於職場專業場合、不同於字面意思的運動俚語）。本課程能幫助學生更清楚地理解英語體育新聞、更周全地與英語人士談論體育、用更加批判性的思維來思考運動在英語世界的文化、語言、日常生活中扮演著怎樣重要的角色。
description.en: Because many people play, watch, and discuss sports every day, being able to talk about sports and to understand sports idioms is very helpful when interacting with English speakers. This course introduces students to English vocabulary that is useful for talking about sports, but also useful in other social situations. (For example, many sports idioms -- such as “to play hardball” and “to strike out” -- are used by businessmen in professional situations not directly related to sports).  The class helps students to understand more clearly English news about sports, to talk more thoughtfully with English speakers about sports, and to think more critically about the important role that sports play in the culture, language, and everyday life of people in the English-speaking world.

notes: 高級

description.zh: 本課程將先從隨機變數的內容開始並主要介紹消息理論的基礎與應用。本課程的將涵蓋下列內容：    (1) 熵值，相對性熵值與互訊息    (2) 漸近等分理論    (3) 隨機程序的熵速率    (4) 資料壓縮    (5) 消息理論與賭博    (6) 頻道容量    (7) 差別熵值    (8) 高斯通道
description.en: This class starts from the review of random process and mainly provides an introduction to information theory. The following is a rough description of the material covered in this class.    (1) Entropy, Relative Entropy, and Mutual information    (2) Asymptotic equipartition theorem    (3) Entropy rates of stochastic processes    (4) Data compression (Huffman coding, Shannon codes, Kraftinequality, etc.)    (5) Information theory and gambling    (6) Channel Capacity    (7) Differential entropy    (8) Gaussian Channels

notes: 電機所和電資外生所合開

description.zh: 本課程涵蓋高分子化學的相關知識及系統設計概念。其內容包括：(1) 基礎高分子原理 (2) 步進式合成機制 (3) 彈性體系統介紹 (4) 鏈成長反應機制 (5) 精密控制鏈成長反應高分子 (6) 前瞻高分子材料設計與應用。
description.en: This course covers the relevant knowledge of polymer chemistry and system design concepts. The contents include:(1) Basic polymer principles (2) Mechanisms of step-growth polymerization (3) Introduction of elastomer systems (4) Mechanisms of chain-growth polymerization (5) Polymers from precisely controlled chain-growth polymerization (6) Designs and applications of advanced polymer materials.

notes: 分子四和高分所合開

description.zh: 選修介紹材料通性、分類與應用，並深入高分子生成之聚合反應、反應機構、反應動力學、熱力學、聚合物之材料構造、聚合方法、分子量之測定、分子量分佈以及一般檢測高分子特性之技術。
description.en: This course is concerned primarily with the synthesis, properties, and technology of synthetic polymers. Topics include polymerization, structure and properties, characterization , and properties of commercial polymers

notes: 網路預選限 30 人

description.zh: 係利用物理機械整理及化學處理方式，改善紡織品之吸引性、服務性和最終用途之機能性。整理加工技術包括結構穩定性 (諸如壓縮、煮呢、蒸呢、熱定型)；表面特性改質 (諸如平滑性、粗糙性、光澤性及其他美觀性質) 與功能性改質 (諸如防縐、防縮、防火、防污、防水、防微生物與昆蟲、耐光、耐冷熱、耐污染質及化學藥劑、耐氣候、耐摩擦、抗起球、抗靜電)。
description.en: The attractiveness, serriceability and end-use performance of textiles are imporved by the application of physical mechanical and chemical processes.  Finishing techniques include dismensional stabilization(such as, sanforization, crabbing, decatizing, heat-setting),modification of surface characteristics(such as, smoothness, roughness, luster, other esthetic fabric qualities) and functional property modification (such as, resistance to wrinkle shrinkage, fire, soils and stains, water, microorganisms and insect, light, heat and cold, air pollutants and chemical agents, weathering, abrasion, pilling and static change).

description.zh: 本課程將帶領同學從兒童詩、繪本、小說、電影來品味兒童文學的真、善與美，藉此喚醒被世俗蒙塵的沉睡心靈，以重返純真的赤子心境。 教學方式以互動為主，期待藉由討論兒童文學名著，閱讀相關論文，來帶領同學進入兒童文學的殿堂。 除了閱讀與討論之外，還會教導同學創作；創作的內容含括了兒童詩及手工繪本製作。希望透過作品的完成，來喚起學生的創作興趣，並建立學生創作的信心。
description.en: This course will lead the students to read the poems, picture books, novels and films of children literature, and hope to find out the beauty of the children's world. Wish in this way can help the sleeping soul to wake up, and return to pure childhood state. This course will try to lead the classmates to appreciate the children's literature by discussing and questioning the masterpieces, hope in this happy way to help the students to get enter the children's literature. Besides reading and discussing, the course will also teach students how to write. The content of writing course would include the poem and the story which would ask the students to finish the work by themselves. Hope through the works, can arouse students' creation interest, and build up students' confidence of creation.

description.zh: 蛋白質與醣類科學課程是為進階研究所學生所設計的。這堂課的目標是在教導學生蛋白質科學和醣類科學最近的發展，以具體應用在醫療和生物科技產業為例子。學生必需要先修以下的課程： 一般有機化學， 生化， 蛋白質結構和醣質科學基礎科學。學生將預計學習蛋白質與醣類之結構， 蛋白質與醣類之生物合成，相關之具生物活性之醫療和生物科技蛋白質和多醣類。
description.en: The course is designed to teach upper level graduate students about the recent advances in protein science and glycobiology with specific application in medical and biotechnological industries. The prerequisite classes for this course are: general organic chemistry, biochemistry, protein structure and glycobiology. Students are expected to learn the structure, biosynthesis, chemistry and cell biology in related to bioactive protein and glycconjugates.

notes: 【停開】

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹微生物及其應用，學生將可習得何謂微生物，微生物如何運作，以及微生物的應用。課程內容包括: (1) 微生物的分類、型態、結構及一般特性；(2) 微生物的生長與控制；(3) 微生物的生理與代謝；(4) 微生物的應用，例如生物轉換、一次及二次代謝產物的生產、基因重組蛋白的生產、核酸藥物的生產等。
description.en: The objective of the course is to introduce the major concepts, principles and applications of microbiology. Students will learn about what microorganisms are, how they function, and their industrial applications. The course include the following topics: (1) Classification and structures; (2) Microbial growth and control; (3) Microbial physiology and metabolism; (4) Applications, such as biotransformation, production of primary and secondary metabolites, production of recombinant proteins, etc.

description.zh: 本課主旨在設計課程，提供練習，俾使學生嫻熟各式的英語測驗，如全民英檢、托福測驗、TOEIC 測驗或類似性質的測驗，希冀能夠藉由本課程的修習，提升學生不斷的學習外國語的興致，並且，藉由通過考試取得證照，增加未來職場的競爭力。
description.en: This course is designed to familiarize the students with various kinds of language proficiency tests such as GEPT, TOEFL, TOEIC and many others to the same end. It is our hope that the students who finish taking the course will go on with their enthusiasm on studying foreign languages; besides, through the acquisition of the certificate when the students pass the tests, they are sure to enhance their capability in the increasingly competitive job markets.

name.en: Course in English language Proficiency Tests

class.name: 專業職場英文銜接計畫

notes: 以 CEFR B1 為目標，新制多益

description.zh: 本課程提供學生及職前專業人士必備之英語文語言技巧，強調電資專業領域之英文溝通能力之訓練。課程內容依學院專業內容區分並整合英語文之聽說讀寫之能力為未來全球化移動及以英語專業溝通人才培育為目標。
description.en: This course aims to provide pre-service Electrical Engineering and Computer Science students/professionals with the adequate skills of the English language and communicative competence to facilitate their current academic and future career pursuits. Students are encouraged to utilize their domain expertise to participate in professional communication in English. Centered on the training of professional use of the English language, the ESP curriculum as the crux of a highly-integrated work of domain knowledge and the English learning development embodies the indispensable credentials required for a global profession.

name.en: ESP(Electrical Engineering and Computer Science) II

notes: 中級

description.zh: 當企業在邁向資訊化與自動化的同時，智慧生產工程師需考量如何整合智慧製造與精實生產。本課程的目標在幫助學生瞭解智慧製造在工廠上的應用，學習建構所謂精實導向的企業。
description.en: Since business are moving toward information and automation, smart production engineers need to consider how to integrate smart manufacturing and lean production. The goal of this course is to help students understand the application of smart manufacturing in the factory and to learn to build a so-called lean-oriented enterprise.

notes: 工管三甲乙丙合開 甲乙 20 人  丙 10 人

description.zh: 本課程將透過閱讀各種文本（包括新聞文章、社論、報告和研究論文）來檢視當代文化中之社會和政治動態。 透過引導學生觀察、分析和理解當代 / 流行文化的複雜性和模糊性是如何與文化傳統同步或是超出文化傳承。本課程將介紹及討論引人入勝的文化故事、事件、議題和趨勢，旨在培養學生的批判性分析能力和文化素養。
description.en: This course examines the social and political dynamics of contemporary culture by reading a variety of texts, including news articles, editorials, reports, and research papers. Students will be guided to observe, analyze and understand the complexity and ambiguity of how contemporary / popular cultural phenomena may move in lockstep with the cultural traditions or fall out of sync in the cultural continuity. The course introduces plenty of fascinating culture stories, event, issues and trends to be studied, aiming to develop students’ critical analysis ability and cultural literacy.

notes: 上限 19 人，大二專業英文 (僅限英文系學生修讀)

description.zh: 本課程欲讓應用英文系學生了解改變社會結構之全球議題與趨勢。特此希望學生在參與討論的過程中，能夠產出對世界有正面效益之改善之道。課堂限制之關係，課程內容將著重於閱讀、答辯，和研討篩選後之報告及新聞，藉以達到上述之目的。
description.en: This course aims to engage English major students in understanding current issues and events taking place in the world that are redefining our global reality and restructuring the world order. A greater goal of such studies of global issues and activities is to urge students to participate in the dialogues and actions to change and to make better of the world. The course content centers on reading, discussing and debating on selected reports and news to uphold all that matters for the aforementioned pursuits.

notes: 上限 20 人，大二專業英文 (僅限英文系學生修讀)

description.zh: 本課程探討衛星通訊系統收發機設計，介紹衛星端與地球站通訊收發資料流。課程涵蓋的主題包括：通訊協定、通道編碼演算法、調變技術、多天線設計、軟體無線電技術、通訊數據機實現。通過這些主題的介紹，學生將了解衛星通訊收發機設計的技巧，並學習以軟體無線電實現通訊數據機。
description.en: This course discusses the design of transceivers for satellite communication systems and introduces the flow of data sent and received in communications between satellites and earth stations. Topics covered in the course include communication protocols, channel coding algorithms, modulation technology, multi-antenna design, software-defined radio technology, and the implementation of communication modem. Through the introduction of these topics, students will understand the techniques of satellite communication transceiver design and learn to implement communication modems using software-defined radios.

notes: 太空所和電子所合開

description.zh: 太空科技應用課程旨在探討太空技術在各種應用領域的應用，與太空科技如何影響人類生活和科學研究。課程涵蓋的主題包括：太空探索，地球觀測，通訊和衛星導航，太空工程和材料科學，太空生物學和醫學，太空經濟和商業。通過這些主題的專題演講與小組討論，學生將了解太空科技在各個領域的應用和未來發展方向，並能夠掌握相關技術和知識。
description.en: The aim of the Space Science & Technology Seminar is to enable students to understand and master practical skills and knowledge in the field of space engineering, as well as to cultivate their teamwork, problem-solving, and innovative thinking abilities. Students will undertake a practical space engineering design project to understand the design, testing, implementation, and management processes of space engineering through practice, and demonstrate project outcomes through reports, presentations, and assessments. Through this course, students can understand the latest developments in the field of space engineering, master relevant skills and knowledge, and enhance their teamwork and project management abilities. This course can also provide practical exercises through industry-academia collaboration.

description.zh: 本課程在視覺心理學的架構下，從設計的角度來檢視視覺、知覺、心理物理學、心理實驗學與視錯覺等的基礎理論與設計應用。
description.en: This course investigates the fundamental theories of visual perception through the lens of design. Topics include vision, perceptual process, space perception, psychophysics, and visual illusion.

notes: 一般教室 (45) 限 15 人，大二 / 外生二合開

description.zh: 設計與生活是自古以來就相生相隨的一項行為，生活型態的變化，對生活器具的要求也就不同。故本課程主要在探討研究設計行為與生活型態之關係，進而提供新思維作為設計行為之參考。
description.en: Design is a part of human life. Demands in design changes with lifestyle. This course focuses on general review of lifestyle research that is practically constructive in the process of product planning and design.

notes: 工設二三四與創新所合開；新聘老師

description.zh: 本課程介紹水文地質的一般原理、概念和分析方法及地下水在實用上的一些問題。主要內容有：水的來、源分、佈與循環、地下水的賦存、地下水的物理性質及化學成分、地下水運動的基本規律、地下的地質作用、地下水的補給、排泄與徑流、地下水資源概況，與地下水有關的環境問題，地下水與工程開發的工程地質問題，水文地質調查概要等。
description.en: The content of this class includes general principles, concepts of hydrological geology and analyzing methods for practical problem related to this subject. It includes: origin of water, distribution and circulation, reserve of underground water, physical and chemical properties of underground water and the relationship between hydrology and engineering geology.  It also discuss environmental concerns of engineering to the hydrology system.

description.zh: 藉由主流神經網路 TensorFlow 框架，操作 Python3 程式，實作諸多機器學習與深度學習神經網路應用，包含影像分類、物件偵測、生成式 AI 與大型語言模型 (LLM) 等等。此課程會使用到 Google Colab 及 PC 端安裝的 Anaconda Python 程式。
description.en: Using the mainstream neural network TensorFlow framework, we will work with Python3 programs to implement a variety of machine learning and deep learning neural network applications, including image classification, object detection, generative AI, and large-scale language modeling (LLM). This course will use Google Colab and the Anaconda Python program installed on the PC.

name.zh: AI 進階機器學習實作課程
name.en: AI Advanced Machine Learning Practical Course

notes: 60 人教室，需自備筆電， 建議具備 Python 基礎程式能力

description.zh: 專題報告、專題演講、研究小組討論。
description.en: Case Study, Seminars, Group meeting

notes: 碩一、二修 國際會議廳

description.zh: (1)	參加「學期制校外實習」的學生，必須同時加選本課程。(2)	學生在企業實習的期間，必須訂出專題的題目。(3)	訓練學生閱讀研討會論文、期刊論文，以及相關的技術論文。(4) 學生必須撰寫「專題報告」交到辦公室保存。
description.en: (1) Students who participate in the off-campus internship must add this course at the same time.(2) During the internship of a company, students must formulate topical topics.(3) Train students to read conference papers, journal papers, and related technical papers.(4) Students must write “Thematic Reports” and submit to the office for preservation.

notes: 須選修學期制校外實習者才可加選本課程

description.zh: 課程主要介紹在計算機科學中常見或基本的資料結構，探討的主題包括: ADT (抽像資料型態) 及複雜度，靜態結構與儲存表示，陣列，堆疊，佇列，串列，樹狀結構，遞迴，排序，搜尋。
description.en: This course is mainly aimed at introducing the data structures commonly used in programming languages which include ADT (abstract data type) and complexity, static structures and their storage representations, arrays, stacks, queues, linked lists, trees, recursion, sorting, and searching.

notes: 一般教室，智動科限 15 人，與機械系合開

description.zh: 先修課程：3001051 或負責教授同意。本課程係以商用繪圖 CAD 軟體（如 TCAD 或 ACAD 等）為教學範本、內容包括二維製圖、三維製圖、修訂功能表、命令腳本（Script）以及圖組 (Block)、圖形功能表等之製作，以輔助機械製圖為主要目標。
description.en: Use commercial CAD softwares (e.g.: Turbo CAD or Auto CAD) as the tutorial examples for Mechanical Drawings, including 2-D and 3-D drawings, to edit and modify the Menu, Script and Block etc..

notes: 限 40 人

description.zh: 介紹各種產能反應的原子分子層級理論，包括燃燒、氫生成反應、氧還原反應、二氧化碳還原反應，和電化學電池、燃料電池，新能源材料等物理化學反應程序，以及低碳應用。
description.en: This course introduces reactions of energy production in the insight of atomic and molecular scale, including combustion, hydrogen evolution reaction, oxygen reduction reaction, carbon dioxide reduction reaction, and physiochemical mechanisms of electrochemical cells, fuel cells, new energy materials, and low-carbon applications.

notes: 一 ABC，與車輛所合開

description.zh: 本門課藉由濕空氣線圖討論空氣調節之過程，分析人體舒適與空氣品質之需求，及各種空調設備系統之設計。本門課在空調負荷計算原理與方法涵蓋輻射熱、熱傳導及熱儲存效應等之分析，系統設計包括送風與送水系統之計算與設計，及室內送風分佈之理論與設計。
description.en: Air-conditioning processes are discussed by using psychrometric charts. Thermal comfort and indoor air quality requirements are presented. Design of air-conditioning equipment and systems are introduced. Air-conditioning load analysis includes radiation, transfer, and heat storage effects. System design includes design and calculation air and water moving systems. Air distribution principles and design are also covered.

notes: 機電二必修和技優二選修合開

description.zh: 深度學習數位影像分析，在近代的製造、醫藥、農業、太空探索、運輸和通信系統等應用領域，正迅速發展中。本課程主要介紹深度學習數位影像分析基本理論基礎，以此概念實際應用到各領域中。課程將探索最先進的深度學習模型，如物件偵測、影像分類，和影像分割，提供實用的實務練習；最後討論數位影像分析深度學習的未來挑戰。課程也將介紹最新的公開影像數據集 (例如 MNIST，CIFAR-10 和 ImageNet)，並涵蓋用於深度學習中的影像數據前處理和樣本標籤註記，詳細探討深度學習模型的評估指標。本課程將使用 Matlab 和 Python 範例，實作教學練習，課程單元包含:●數位影像分析簡介●深度學習基礎●影像分析領域之深度學習基本介紹●卷積神經網絡●訓練卷積神經網絡●遷移式學習●深度學習數位影像數據標籤註記●深度學習模型評估方式●深度學習在數位影像分析領域之挑戰●超引數優化●激活函式●損失函式●優化函式
description.en: This course covers the basics of deep learning for digital image analysis, including theoretical concepts and practical applications. Students will learn about object detection, image classification, and segmentation using state-of-the-art deep learning models. The course will also address the challenges of using deep learning in digital image analysis and cover popular image datasets such as MNIST, CIFAR-10, and ImageNet. Additionally, students will gain hands-on experience in image data preparation and labeling, and learn about evaluation metrics for deep learning models. Programming examples will be provided in Python or Matlab. The course includes:●A gentle introduction to digital image analysis and deep learning.●Convolutional neural networks.●Transfer learning.●Image data labeling for deep learning.●Evaluating deep learning models.●The challenges of deep learning in the field of digital image analysis.●Activation functions.●Loss functions.●Optimizers.

name.zh: 深度學習數位影像分析
name.en: Deep Learning for Digital Image Analysis

notes: 電機所和電資外生所合開

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹生產業與服務業中之作業管理。其中包含預測、產品與服務設計、產能規劃、地點選擇規劃分析、存貨管理、及時系統與供應鏈管理、專案管理、及品質管理。
description.en: The purpose of the course is to introduction operation management in industry and service. It includes forecasting, product and service design, capacity planning, location selection and analysis planning, inventory management, just-in-time and supply chain management, project management, and quality management.

notes: 工管三甲乙 20 人丙 10 人和經管三合開

description.zh: 本科目將由不可壓縮流體在各種流動環境所產生之流體分子流動現象之認識，進而利用各種有關因次群，熟習包含可壓縮流體在內之實際應用上所必須具備之基礎方法；如雷諾數．伯努力方程式等。利用流利基礎分析，流體機械之流場與動力，及管路內流場與壓力之變化。
description.en: Introduction to flow phenomena of incompressible flow, discussion on the dimensionless groups and their applicants, derive the conservation equations such as the Bernoulli equation, using fluid mechanics to analyze the field and the dynamics of fluid machinery, pipe and duct flow are also discuss.

description.zh: 本課程將介紹工程上、物理上系統解析的相關數學工具，內容包括：1. 向量幾何與分析：矩陣行列式及特徵問題。2. 傅立葉級數，積分及轉換。3. 偏微分方程及邊界值問題。
description.en: This course intends to introduce the mathematical principles and practices that today's engineers need to know. The course contents are 1. Vector Algebra and Vector Analysis: Matrices and Determinants, Eigenvalue problems. 2. Fourier Series, Integral and Transforms. 3. Partial Differential Equations and Boundary Value Problems.

notes: 與機械二合開

description.zh: 科技日文主要是以培養閱讀日文科技期刊或論文能力為重點，俾充實大學理工系、所學生參考日文系列技術論文或工程手冊時之理解、翻譯與書寫方式。課程內容包含：    1. 論文閱讀練習    2. 翻訣技巧    3. 技術論文之書寫
description.en: This course will direct students to learn the ability of reading and writing Japanese journals, papers engineering instruction manuals or reference materials. This course include:1.  papers reading practice2.  translation skill3.  technical writing

description.zh: 高科技產業的專利攻防已變成產業策略之一，越來越多的訴訟案件逼使廠商進行專利迴避設計。事實上台灣的產業界對於迴避設計、專利策略與專利佈局理論上並不陌生，但在實務上卻很少實際執行，所以每年仍然付出數十億美金的權利金。本課程將從專利申請策略開始，告訴同學專利申請上常見的錯誤，如何以較低的成本取得、維護我國專利，並利用我國專利進行全球專利佈局。
description.en: Patent litigation, either initiation or defense, has become one of the high-tech industrial strategies, and more and more patent suit cases have forced the manufacturers to undertake patent design around. In fact, the industrial fields in Taiwan, theoretically, do not feel strange on design around and patent strategies. However, in practice, they perform much less. That is the reason why Taiwan still has to pay more than five billion US dollars each year for royalty. This course will start from patent filing strategy, getting patent claims well known, then following with introduction on orientation of patent strategies, and providing theory and practice on patent strategies. The outline of this course is given as follows: Patent claim interpretation; Process of patent infringement analysis; Requirements of patent design around; Patent strategy analysis; Practice on patent strategies; and Study on patent cases.

name.zh: 高科技專利取得與攻防
name.en: High Tech Patent Applications and Protections

notes: 機械大四、機電所和智財所合開，大學部限 13 人

description.zh: 工程分析概論，有限元素模型建立，進階模組技巧，實體模型的建立，一維元素分析，二維元素分析，三維元素分析，進階範例。
description.en: Introduction to Engineering Analysis, Finite Element Model Constructing, Advanced Techniques of Module, Solid models Constructing, One-dimensional Analysis, Two-dimensional Analysis, Three-dimensional Analysis, Advanced Examples.

name.zh: 電腦輔助工程分析及實習
name.en: Computer Aided Engineering Analysis and Lab.

notes: 機械大四合開，限 13 人

description.zh: 自動化應用基礎，自動化規劃設計︰1. 個體冷凍設備 2. 冷凍系統運轉操作 3. 冷凍倉儲管理自動化 4. 低溫冷凍應用自動化
description.en: Fundamentals and design of automation applications include:1. Unitary refrigeration equipment.2. Refrigerating system operation.3. Refrigerated warehousing management.4. Low temperature refrigeration application.

notes: 日職合開

description.zh: 熱傳學主要內容是研究由於溫度梯度所造成能量傳遞之一門學問﹐為一般冷凍、空調、食品冷藏及各類型熱交換器設計之基本知識程，其他大如各類發電廠，小如電腦微晶片散熱亦有密切關係。本課程之安排以奠定學生在熱傳方面之智能，作為未來進入冷凍、空調與能源相關學門之踏腳石。
description.en: 1.	熱傳導定律之推導2.	一維及多維的穩態與暫態熱傳分析，3.	散熱片之設計，利用數值方法解熱傳導問題，4.	對流原理之推導5.	強迫對流方面的分析及應用-層流邊界層，管道內層流熱傳6.	自然對流方面的分析及應用-管道外與封閉空間內自然對流        熱傳7.	紊流的基本性，紊流邊界層，管道內紊流8.	具相變化的熱對流:凝結與沸騰9.	熱交換器設計介紹Advanced Heat Transfer  Credit: 3 Course Outline1.	Derivation of heat conduction principles 2.	One and multi-dimentional steady and transient heat         conduction analysis3.	Heat transfer from extended surfaces, numerical heat         conduction analysis4.	Derivation of convection principles 5.	Forced convection - laminar boundary layers and     laminar heat transfer in ducts6.	Nature convection over external surfaces and in internal enclosures 7.	Fundamentals of turbulence, turbulent boundary layers, turbulent flow in ducts8.	Heat transfer with phase change: boiling and condensation9.	Introduction to heat-exchanger design

notes: 日職合開

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。探討專利相關法規及其應用：專利重要法規，專利實體審查基準，專利案例閱讀與分析，專利舉發 ，專利行政救濟，專利侵權鑑定，專利迴避性設計，簡易專利地圖製作，專利應用範例。
description.en: Discussing the patent laws and its applications, it includes:●A few important patent laws●Guidelines for substantive examination for invention patent●Practices in applying for patents●Practices in patent invalidations●Patent administrative remedy●Theories in patent infringement assessment●Innovative designing around patent●Patent mapsPatent cases study

name.zh: 高科技專利取得與攻防
name.en: High Tech Patent Applications and Protections

notes: 機械大四、機電所和智財所合開，研究所限 7 人

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技四年級上學期實施選修專項分組教學，課程修畢有一學分並計入畢業學分內。由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: In first semester, Senior students can choose to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. When they are finishing the course that can get the credit, also can account in graduate credit.  For Senior level, Classes are giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in.  Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技四年級上學期實施選修專項分組教學，課程修畢有一學分並計入畢業學分內。由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: In first semester, Senior students can choose to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. When they are finishing the course that can get the credit, also can account in graduate credit.  For Senior level, Classes are giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in.  Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

notes: * 籃球 B (選)/ 組隊方式選課，請洽授課教師，分機 3305

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

notes: * 適應體育

description.zh: 本課程之教學目標在使學生瞭解數位訊號處理的理論基礎及其應用技巧。課程內容包含：(1) 離散傅立葉轉換及快速傅立葉轉換 (2) Z - 轉換在信號處理上之應用 (3) 相關函數，迴旋積分及其應用 (4) FIR 數位濾波器設計 (5) IIR 數位濾波器設計 (6) 適應性訊號處理介紹 (7) 工程應用及實例研討。
description.en: This course introduces the basic theory of digital signal processing and its application. The course outline includes: (1) Discrete-time Fourier Transform and Fast Fourier Transform (2) Z-Transform and its application (3) Correlation Fucntion, Convoluation Integral and its application (4) FIR digital filter design (5) IIR Digital Filter Desgin (6) Adaptive Signal Processing (7) Practical Application

description.zh: 電池分類，電池化學，電池功能及表現，電池之製造，電池使用注意事項，電池檢驗及測試，電池選擇及安裝，燃料電池，電動車使用之電池未來高級電池之介紹。
description.en: Battery Classification，Battery Chemistry，Battery Function and Performance，Battery Manufacturing，Battery service Precautions，Battery Inspection and Testing，Battery Selection and Installation，Fuel Battery， Battery for the Electric Vehicle，Introduction to the Advanced Future Battery.

description.zh: 本課程旨在探討人工智慧在跨域資安上的應用。課程將從零信任安全、人工智慧安全、個人資料與隱私保護、人工智慧在資訊安全事件的偵測、人工智慧在舞弊的偵測、人工智慧輔助電腦稽核、人工智慧輔助數位鑑識以及 API 安全等議題進行深入探討。首先，在零信任安全的概念上，探討如何使用此方法來保障資料安全，接著探討人工智慧安全的基礎知識，包括機器學習、深度學習等技術，並介紹如何將這些技術應用於資安領域。此外，在人工智慧在安全的應用上，將導入人工智慧在入侵偵測、漏洞掃描、安全威脅評估等方面的應用案例，以及如何使用人工智慧技術進行網路安全防禦。在人工智慧在資訊安全事件的偵測方面，將介紹如何使用人工智慧技術檢測網路攻擊，包括異常檢測、入侵檢測等技術。最後，課程還將介紹 API 安全，包括 API 安全的風險與漏洞、API 保護措施等方面的內容，並介紹如何使用人工智慧技術保護 API 的安全性。
description.en: This course aims to explore the application of artificial intelligence in cross-domain cybersecurity. First, the course will introduce the concept of zero-trust security and discuss how this method can be used to safeguard data security. In addition, the course will also explore the application of AI in security, including case studies in intrusion detection, vulnerability scanning, security threat assessment, and how AI can be used for network security defense and protect personal data and privacy. In addition, the use of AI technology for detecting cybersecurity incidents, including detecting network attacks using techniques such as anomaly detection and intrusion detection. It will also explore fraud detection using AI, such as credit card fraud or malicious top-up fraud. Lastly, the course will introduce API security, including risks and vulnerabilities, API protection measures, and how to use AI technology to protect API security.

name.zh: 人工智慧跨域資安之應用
name.en: Artificial Intelligence Cross-domain Applications in Information Security

notes: 資財三四甲資財所合開

description.zh: 電腦稽核已廣泛的應用在金融交易，企業財務與進銷存流程與資訊系統的各項領域來協助找出瑕疵，降低與防範風險，並能做趨勢預測。本課程的目的將機器學習與人工智慧的技術應用在電腦稽核領域，主題包含：電腦稽核的流程，大量資料的整理與萃取，監督式與非監督式學習在稽核的應用，資料視覺化技術等。
description.en: Computer auditing has been widely used in financial transactions, enterprise business processes, and information systems, which is to help find flaws and reduce risks, and be able to predict trends. The purpose of this course is to apply machine learning technology in the field of computer auditing. Topics include Computer auditing related processes, the extraction and manipulation of large-scaled data, supervised and unsupervised learning in auditing applications, data visualization technology.

name.zh: 機器學習輔助電腦稽核

notes: 資財四甲乙資財所、創新資安、電資資安合開

description.zh: 本課程主要介紹大數據技術在金融方面的應用，課程內容包括資料準備、大數據分法、金融決策介紹、大數據在金融的應用、金融資料介紹、金融大數據分法、金融大數據專題實作。
description.en: This course is to introduce the use of big data techniques on financial applications. The course will cover data preparation, big data methods, introduction to financial decision, big data applications on finance, financial data preparation, financial big data methods, project implementation on financial big data.

notes: 資財四甲資財所合開

description.zh: 本課程能夠讓修課學生靈活的運用各種大數據探勘與分析演算法、社群文字探勘及機器學習演算法等技術，分析各項金融資料。透過實際金融數據分析案例及實務資料操做，補強資訊背景學生之金融產業知識，並讓修課同學了解資訊科技於金融資料分析之實務應用，以培育業界金融科技人才。課程內容以模組的方式進行，包括：「數據分析」、「機器學習」以及「金融大數據實務」。課程也將擷取網路中的開放財經數據，進行金融資料之預處理、分析及預測結果之驗證，協助修課學生建構高預測能力及穩定性之數據探勘模型。
description.en: This course teaches students to use various techniques of big data mining and analysis algorithms, text mining of social media, and machine learning algorithms to analyze financial data. In this course, by case study and open software operation (such as R ), we will strengthen the financial knowledge of information background students. Also, the students can understand how to select and well organize various information technologies (particular the data analysis technique) to analyze financial data. The course is organized in modules, including "Data Analysis", "Machine Learning" and "Big Data Practice for Financial Data analysis." The course will also teach students to collect open financial data from the Internet, and experience the KDD process, including: data pre-processing and data analysis, to establish a prediction model with high forecasting ability and stability.

notes: 資財四甲資財所合開

description.zh: 國際能源署 (IEA) 呼籲全球國家訂定淨零碳排路徑，國內也發佈「台灣 2050 淨零路徑及策略」，具體宣告了淨零碳排的目標期程與行動方案，針對建築部門納入低碳 (低蘊含碳) 建築評估 (Low Embodied-carbon Building Rating System, LBERS)，藉由標準化、透明化的建築資訊來剖析建築生命週期各階段對環境的影響，以培養永續淨零概念並具備評估整棟建築生命週期的碳足跡、甚進一步提出減碳熱點，了解建築物的節碳潛力所在。了解國內外淨零碳排路徑策略、具備建築物生命週期的整體流程概念、具備建築碳足跡計算操作能力。
description.en: IEA (The International Energy Agency) proposes to set a global net carbon emission roadmap, and domestically launch a net target and action plan, targeting the building sector, the Low Embodied-carbon Building Rating System(LBERS) a simple and effective assessment tool to evaluates the carbon footprint of a building's life cycle through standardized and transparent building information, the impact of various stages of the building life cycle on the environment is analyzed step by step. This course not only evaluates the carbon footprint of the entire building life cycle but also further identifies carbon hotspots and provides carbon reduction strategies, hence understanding carbon savings potential of buildings.

name.en: The Evaluation for Bulding’s Carbon Footprint

notes: 設計館 164 討論室

description.zh: 本課程的目的是研究人與環境互動的關係，介紹環境心理學發展的過程及相關的理論。並藉由觀察與評估現有生活環境中的行為，增進我們對環境心理學中在理論與經驗上不同取向的瞭解。課程內容包括 1. 緒論 2. 研究方法及理論架構 3. 建成環境，由家環境到城市空間 4. 社會行為及實質環境 5. 自然環境與行為 6. 使用者用後評估 7. 結論
description.en: The purpose of this course is to explore the interaction relationships between human and environment, introducing the development and theory of environmental psychology. Via observing and evaluating the behavior of present living environment, enhance our knowledge about environmental psychology through various approaches to theories and experiences. The course includes:1. Introduction  2. Research methods and theory framework 3. The built environment from home environment to city space 4. Social behavior and the physical environment 5. The natural environment and behavior 6. Post-occupancy evaluation 7. Conclusion

description.zh: 本課程重點在探討人們日常生活與工作時，置身其間的理想環境及適用的器物設備；在從事建築、室內及產品等環境相關設計時所應考慮的人體特徵、心理反應、動作行為及人類心理和生理上可承受的負荷，特別是人 / 環境系統間的相對配合問題，以獲得安全、效率與舒適為目的。
description.en: Human factors is dedicated to discover and survey human beings' capability, limit, behavior and other futures. And then apply it to the design of architecture, interior, product, systems and environments in order to enhance the quality of life and productivity. The course includes research approaches, physical design, human being's feeling process and information process, human/machine interface, operating environments, and safety.

notes: 工設三四與創新所合開；上限 13 人

description.zh: 設計的溝通扮演著如何將設計理念成功地傳達以及讓使用者清楚的理解設計本意的重要角色。本課程將透過設計思考過程藉由文字、口說、圖面等達到設計溝通之目的及訓練，經由了解設計領域應用之文字搭配口說及圖面進而增進設計者說明設計概念的溝通能力。課程內容包含設計溝通的基本原則、技巧及策略，以及如何利用不同的溝通媒介及工具來傳達設計理念。課程操作包含案例分析搭配實際的簡報演練及口說訓練讓同學們累積應用經驗。
description.en: Design Communication plays an important role in how to successfully deliver design concepts and have users understand the design intention clearly. This course will practice and reach the goal of design communication through design thinking by vocabulary uses, verbal speeches, and image presentations.  From understanding the proper application of design language including vocabularies and diagrams in various design fields, designers may improve their skills of concept presentation and communication.  The course content includes basic principles, techniques, and strategies in design communication as well as how to use different media and tools to deliver design concepts.Course activities include case studies with presentation practice and oral speech to help students have experiences in actual application.

notes: 建築一和三合開

description.zh: 本課程主要以公平交易法與營業秘密法之立法目的、沿革及發展趨勢為出發點，探討此二法律在規範對象、方法及競合等之差異；深入分析公平交易法與營業秘密法之內涵，進而個別探討公平交易法與營業秘密法等之智財權利行使的課題。
description.en: This course majors in the purpose, evolution, and development trend of legislation on the Fair Trade Act and the Trade Secret Act, with an attempt to differentiate between the two Acts in respect of objects, approaches, and choice of law that the Acts apply to.  In this course, analyses are also made, in depth, on the essence of the Fair Trade Act and the Trade Secret Act, together with discussion, respectively, on implementation of Intellectual Property Rights involved in the Fair Trade Act and the Trade Secret Act.

name.zh: 營業秘密法與公平交易法專題研究
name.en: Monographic Study on Trade Secret Act and Fair Trade Act

description.zh: 本課程著重於隨機流量網路 (stochastic flow network) 的可靠度評估、分析和決策。在整個課程中，我們將介紹與隨機流量網路相關的數值分析方法、模擬技術和最佳化問題。此外，我們將在隨機流量網路模型的框架內深入探討最快路徑、多商品、路由政策和負載管理問題等主題。學生將有機會將這些方法和模型應用到實際系統中，包括電腦網路、電信、城市交通系統、電力傳輸網路和製造系統。
description.en: This course emphasizes the reliability evaluation, analysis, and decision-making aspects of stochastic flow networks. Throughout the course, we will introduce analytical methodologies, simulation techniques, and optimization problems related to stochastic flow networks. Furthermore, we will delve into topics like quickest path, multi-commodity, routing policies, and load management issues within the framework of stochastic flow network models. Students will have the opportunity to apply these methodologies and models to practical systems, including computer networks, telecommunications, urban traffic systems, power transmission networks, and manufacturing systems.

notes: 工管所和管理博、IMBA 合開

description.zh: 本課程重點在探討人們日常生活與工作時，置身其間的理想環境及適用的器物設備；在從事建築、室內及產品等環境相關設計時所應考慮的人體特徵、心理反應、動作行為及人類心理和生理上可承受的負荷，特別是人 / 環境系統間的相對配合問題，以獲得安全、效率與舒適為目的。
description.en: Human factors is dedicated to discover and survey human beings' capability, limit, behavior and other futures. And then apply it to the design of architecture, interior, product, systems and environments in order to enhance the quality of life and productivity. The course includes research approaches, physical design, human being's feeling process and information process, human/machine interface, operating environments, and safety.

notes: 工設三四與創新所合開；上限 7 人

description.zh: 本課程引入生活性的學習方法來誘發學生學習動機，並培養可在社會與職場運用的四項英文基本技能。課程目標在幫助學生在生活實境習得英文，為他們裝備可溝通表達於日常、社交活動，並提升職涯的整合性英文技能。每堂課程都注重在以學生為中心的學習活動中帶入全真、應用性高的英文技巧。課程設計涵蓋的功能包括課堂分享與作業、日常互動英文以及專業英文練習。主要課題包括溝通，簡報與談判技巧，應用閱讀與寫作，聽力技巧運用，語言與文化。
description.en: This course introduces real-world based learning approaches for students to raise their learning aspirations and to develop four essential English skills that are applicable in social and professional encounters. This course aims to help students practice English in most real-life settings and to equip them with integrated skills to advance their careers. Every class session focuses on bringing authentic and applied English in student-centered leaning activities. The class design covers the functions like information sharing and task-based activities, social interactions, and professional English practices. Essential topics include communication, techniques of negotiation and presentation, applied reading and writing, strategies for developing listening skills and language learning across cultures.

notes: 限管理學院學生

description.zh: 本課程將教授學生 FPGA 程式開發、硬體系統設計、和如何利用 FPGA 加速深度學習演算法。課程大綱如下：1. Xilinx & Vivado 開發環境 2. High-level Synthesis (HLS) & SystemC 程式開發 3. Finite Impulse Response (FIR) Filters4. Discrete Fourier Transform & Fast Fourier Transform5. Matrix Multiplication6. Prefix Sum and Histogram7. Video Systems8. Deep Learning Implementation on FPGA9. Pruning & Quantization10. Object Detection on FPGA
description.en: This course teaches FPGA programming, hardware system design, and how to implement and accelerate Deep Learning Algorithms on FPGA. The syllabus is shown below:1. Xilinx & Vivado IDE2. High-level Synthesis (HLS) & SystemC3. Finite Impulse Response (FIR) Filters4. Discrete Fourier Transform & Fast Fourier Transform5. Matrix Multiplication6. Prefix Sum and Histogram7. Video Systems8. Deep Learning Implementation on FPGA9. Pruning & Quantization10. Object Detection on FPGA

notes: 電子四甲乙合開

description.zh: 本課程教導及訓練研究生有關英文在管理領域內特定專題的溝通運用，學生將在本課程中以英文學習: (1) 管理常見之專有名詞，(2) 英語備忘錄的草擬與撰寫，(3) 會議資料如：議程、動議、記錄等的準備與撰寫，(4) 企業計劃書的編寫，及 (5) 現代化全球管理相關專題英文資料的閱讀與溝通討論。學生必須在課堂上就選定的管理題材以英文做報告與其它同學討論。
description.en: This course teaches students the communication in English on the special topics within the context of management. Students are expected to learn the followings in English: (1) Terminologies commonly used in management; (2) Draft and write-up of English memorandum; (3) Development of meeting materials such as agenda, motions, minutes, etc.; (4) Business proposals and plans; and (6) Contemporary topics and trend in global management issues. Students will be required to make group presentations and discussions on the selected management topics in English.

description.zh: 這門課程主要是介紹資料庫系統的理論與應用，內容包含有： 1. 資料庫系統的介紹與架構 2. ER 資料模式 3. 檔案儲存結構 4. 關連式資料模式 5. SQL 查詢語言 6. ER 資料模式與關連式資料模式之間的轉換 7. 資料庫正規化 8. 最佳化查詢 9. 交易處理
description.en: This course provides introduction to both database system theory and application. These are the following : o 1. Database System Concepts and Architecture -2. Data Modeling Using the Entity-Relationship Model --3. Record Storage and Primary File Organizations -4. -The Relational Data Model -5. SQL -6. ER- and ERR-to Relational Mapping -7. Functional Dependencies and Normalization for Relational Databases -8. Query Processing and Optimization -9. Transaction Processing Concepts

notes: 創新 AI、電資 AI 合開

description.zh: 本課程是研究所程度進階的巨量資料探勘與應用課程，主要介紹巨量資料探勘概念和原理、分散式計算基本架構、及各種應用包括: Link Analysis、Social Network Graph Mining、推薦系統等，並且將介紹在處理巨量資料時常用的機器學習方法，如：類神經網路、SVM 等，除了觀念的介紹外，透過平行化程式設計的練習以及期末專題，能讓學生認識實際巨量資料探勘的程式設計以及機器學習等工具的應用方式。
description.en: This course introduces the concepts in big data mining and advanced applications in machine learning. Topics include big data concepts, distributed computing infrastructure, and machine learning methods commonly used in processing big data, such as neural networks, support vector machines. In addition to concept introduction, parallel programming exercises and term projects are included to help students understand the processing steps and practical tools in big data anlaytics.

notes: 創新 AI、電資 AI 合開

description.en: In this course, we will invite speakers from the academia, industry and government to lectures on topics in computer science and information engineering.

description.zh: 本課程將由個人資料保護原則開始對個人資料保護作全面性的介紹，並說明《個人資料保護法》與《個人資料保護法施行細則》如何與個資保護原則互相呼應，期使學生瞭解目前個人資料保護的管理議題與實務考量，並且說明可參考的標準與指引，以強化學生對於個人資料保護的基礎概念。藉由《個人資料保護法》及《個人資料保護法施行細則》的介紹帶入 ISO/IEC 29100 的個資保護框架、隱私衝擊評鑑 (PIA)，接下介紹 ISO/IEC 27701 個資保護實作指引等相關國際標準，本課程以實際的案例以及國際標準讓學生這對於個人資料保護有更進一步的概念與瞭解。
description.en: This course will begin with a comprehensive introduction to personal data protection principles and explain in detail the "Personal Data Protection Act" and the "Enforcement Rules of the Personal Data Protection Act". Student will learn managerial and practical considerations of personal data protection. Relevant standards and guidelines, such as ISO/IEC 29100, ISO/IEC 27701, will be discussed to strengthen students' understanding of fundamental concepts of personal information management systems (PIMS). In addition, the process of a privacy impact assessment (PIA) and its related standard ISO/IEC 29134 will also be introduced in this course. All in all, this course aims to give students a solid understanding of personal data protection through cases studies and international standards.

notes: 資財所、創新資安、電資資安合開

description.zh: 資訊安全保險相關事故的理賠調查，使得數位鑑識在金融或資訊領域的重要性日益提升。數位鑑識與調查課程主要說明如何找到入侵或犯罪留下的可能的足跡，並介紹如何在合法與符合鑑識程序規範的前提下蒐集足夠的證據並保護這些有用的證據，以做為未來訴訟有效的佐證。在課程的設計上將以數位鑑識相關國際證照的領域與內容為主，除了教授學生數位鑑識的專業知識外，期能輔導學生取得數位鑑識相關證照。
description.en: The cyber security incident investigation for the cyber insurance has made digital forensics more and more important in the financial or information industry. This course focuses on identifying possible footprints of intrusions or crimes and collecting sufficient evidence and protect such useful evidence in order to be effective in future litigation. In the design of the course, the domain and content of the digital forensics international certification licenses will be mainly used. In addition to teaching the professional knowledge of digital forensics, it can also help the students obtain digital forensics certification in the future.

notes: 資財四甲乙、資財所、創新資安、電資資安合開

description.zh: 本課程期望學生能夠能有獨立思考的能力，對產品建構出合理的實驗設計架構，透過採集人的生理與心理數據對產品進行人因工程評估，最後將實驗發現應用於產品的重新設計上，讓產品能夠更符合使用者的需求與認知。
description.en: In this course, students are expected to demonstrate independent thinking, develop a reasonable experimental design, conduct ergonomics evaluations on products by collecting both physiological and psychological data, and ultimately apply the findings to redesign products. This ensures that the products align more effectively with the needs and perceptions of users.

name.en: Ergonomics evaluation and redesign in products

notes: 工管所和管理博、IMBA 合開

description.zh: 逆向工程已成為電腦輔助產品開發技術重要的一環，透過三次元量測或掃瞄技術，取得工件表面的點資料，據以建構 3D CAD 幾何模型 (Geometric model)，以供後續設計、電腦輔助工程分析 (CAE) 與電腦輔助製造 (CAM) 之應用。逆向工程的程序分為三個階段：(1) 擷取工件表面的點資料；(2) 點資料的前置處理；以及 (3) 建構或更新幾何模型。依此流程，本課程首先講述各類運用於逆向工程中的量測與掃瞄技術，並以設計應用觀點為基礎，討論其間的差異與優缺點，隨著運用領域的不同，而採取不同的量測技術；其次介紹點資料前置處理的理念與方法，從現有文獻中，解析的相關的技術，因量測技術與策略的差異，而發展出不同的處理技術；至於，重建或更新原有的幾何模型的部分，將著重設計實務的應用，並與現有的 CAD 系統整合的策略。課程之目標，為使修習本課程之學生能對逆向工程的相關理論與技術，有全盤的認識與瞭解，並透過實際案例的操作，訓練學生能具備實務作業能力。
description.en: Reverse engineering has become an important tool for geometric model construction in 3D CAD based on the data points, digitized from an existing part, for the downstream applications such as CAE and CAM. The process of reverse engineering can usually be subdivided into three stages, i.e. (1) part digitization for capturing the data points; (2) data point pre-processing; and (3) CAD modeling and/or updating. In this course, the relevant techniques in the three stages of reverse engineering procedure are introduced firstly. Through the project practice, the student is able to adept to the techniques of reverse engineering.

notes: 工設二三四和創新所合開；上限 13 人

description.zh: 本課程規劃透過專業之人格特質分析方式，提供學生瞭解自我屬性於未來職場上之可能角色定位與認知感受，並針對學生畢業後進入職場將面臨的挑戰，提供應對進退之教戰策略與技巧傳授，包括壓力調適方式、溝通協調技巧、團隊合作注意事項、履歷撰寫方式、面試臨場技巧、以及職場倫理規範等，以提升學生爭取工作機會與進入職場後之適應能力與競爭實力。課程最後並安排整體課程之履歷健檢與模擬面試實作教育訓練，提供學生檢視學習成效並對未來職涯規劃預作準備。
description.en: This course is designed to provide students with a professional personality analysis to understand the possible roles and perceptions of their attributes in the future workplace, and to teach them strategies and skills to cope with the challenges they will face when they enter the workplace after graduation, include stress adjustment, communication, and coordination skills, teamwork, resume writing, interviewing skills, and workplace ethics, etc. This course will also help students to enhance their adaptability and competitiveness when they enter the workplace. At the end of the course, a resume review and a mock interview will be provided to prepare students for their future career planning.

notes: 履歷面試實際演練，前九週星期三 34 節上課

Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 透過分析創新成功之實際個案，讓修課同學了解創新的本質。課程中將介紹不同類型的創新個案，包括：技術創新、產品創新、服務創新與管理創新。本課程也擬搭配邀請成功之創業顧問與談，提供實務經驗，分享創業者該有的認知以及創業的重要理念，當然也包括分享他們在邀創業過程中所面臨的各類挑戰。創業是每個人都曾經懷抱過的夢想，透過創新成功之個案的分析，可以了解到個案公司是如何有步驟的循序漸進。針對每個個案，我們要求每位同學於課前完成個案的閱讀，並於上課前交出本次課程的課前預習心得。我們希望每位參與的同學都能在討論時充分表達意見，遇有不清楚或不同意見時能夠勇於提出他們的看法。本課程擬營造出一種研究的環境，讓學生可以針對個案盡其所能清楚的提出建議並來說服同儕。
description.en: The course enable participant to realize the essential features of innovation via cases study. Various types of innovation cases are included, such as: technology innovation, service innovation and management innovation. We also plan to invites some successful constants to give participants talk and share their experiences, including the challenge and their resolving process.The real case study enables participants to understand the entrepreneurship and the steps to start a business. The participants are required to complete the case reading and a preview report is required in advance the class. We hope that every participant can propose their opinion and persuade others colleges of their viewpoints.

notes: 創創向度

description.zh: 音樂概論以透過此課程讓學生對音樂有總體認識，了解音樂的元素、技術理論及文化背景，同時在探索音樂美感構成上的標準，我們可以從探索不同歷史時期的人文思想背景，了解對於當時音樂創作理念與風格發展的影響，以及音樂審美觀念的發展演變之影響，立基於探索音樂的發展方向、藝術本質及審美意涵，對音樂藝術概念及美學思想之延伸探討。
description.en: Through this course—Introduction to Music, students would have a general understanding of music, understand the elements of music, technical theory and cultural background, at the same time in the music aesthetic to explore the composition of the standard, through exploring the different historical periods of humanistic background, to understand for the time that the idea of music composing and the impact of musical style development, as well as the development of music aesthetic concept of the evolution of the impact, based on discussing the development of music, the essence of art, and aesthetic meaning, to develop the concept of musical art, as well as a probe into the extension of aesthetic thought.

notes: 人文與藝術向度

description.zh: 人類從尚未有文字的歷史以來，就有各種不同規模的戰爭，戰爭很吊詭的以你死或我亡，相互毀滅之態勢，爭奪「活著」的條件。古今中外，爆發戰爭的因素或為爭奪領土、權位、或為族群之戰、為意識形態之戰、或為物質資源之爭奪。在視覺影像發達的今日社會，有關戰爭的歷史影像的紀錄片與劇情片數量龐大、並有許多可觀之處。本課程將利用這些描寫戰爭影像資料，帶領同學瞭解相關戰爭與戰役爆發的歷史及其經過。
description.en: Throughout human history, even prior to written record, various types of warfare and scales of battles have existed for various purposes of domination or survival by all means of cruelty and destruction. The arousal of violent conflicts might be an attempt at fighting for territorial dominion or material resources economically or altering another species ideologically. In today's modern societies, bountiful documentaries and films concerning historical warfare have been accumulated. This course will aim at giving students a broad understanding and profound knowledge of the causes, process, and effects of significant warfare in human history with the aid of visual images in different media.

notes: 106-108：歷史與文化選修。109 (含) 後：人文與藝術

description.zh: 「生活美學」是現代人依據東西方文化及各方美學的定義所推論出來的名詞，指應用於「生活」中食、衣、住、行、育、樂所體現美的內容及活動。依循相異的生活型態、社會環境，人類試圖重構生活藝術化與藝術生活化的當代美學。
description.en: “Aesthetics of living " will address the East-West cultural and aesthetic experience through series of questions that drive the discourse in contemporary life’s content and activities. Following the different lifestyles, social environment, human tries to reconstruct everyday life into contemporary aesthetics of living. This course aims to encourage students to think what is aesthetic of living, through the real life and spiritual life and concerned itself with the aesthetic problems in the lives of others.

notes: 106-108：美學與藝術核心。109 (含) 後：人文與藝術

description.zh: 教學目標：針對當前社會中之政治、經濟、社會、文化等各層面所形成之重大問題與現象加以探討，予以概略整合性之介紹，以使學生對社會現況更加瞭解並進而關懷所生活之環境。開課基礎：以原開設之社會科學概論為基礎，而向實務面擴充之課程。教學內容：採單元教學、口授、作業、探討意見交換並行方式進行。1. 真正的民意－政治生態與國會。2. 尖銳的對立－政黨競爭。3. 台灣經驗－經濟奇蹟。4. 高齡化的社會－銀髮族與人生。5. 應關懷的族群－社福。6. 立國的基礎－教育改革。7. 慾望街車－犯罪與司法。8. 和平發展之關鍵－兩岸關係。9. 其他。
description.en: Teaching goal: Analyze the significant problems and phenomena concerning politics, economy, society and culture, and give a brief account of such phenomena with a view to facilitating students' understanding of the status quo and encouraging students to devote care to their living environment. Pre-course requirement: A basic grasp of "the Introduction of Social Science" is required for more advanced and expanded discussions in this course are based on it. Teaching activities: Lecturing, assignments, and discussions. Teaching units: Political patterns and parliament, Competition of Parties, Taiwan Economical Miracle, Elders and Their Life, Welfare for Minorities, Education Reformation, Crime and Justice, Cross-affair Relations, Others.

notes: 106-108：社會與哲學選修。109 (含) 後：社會與法治

description.zh: 介紹日常生活中所經常遭遇到的案例使學生認識法律上之常識，培養學生珍惜法律上所賦予之權利，並及時行使庶免讓權利睡著了，致蒙受意外損害。並督促學生善盡法律上之責任，蔚為人人知法，人人守法的風尚，導致社會祥和。授課內容：按民法總則、債篇、物權、親屬、繼承各篇之順序，選擇與日常生活關係最密切之案例，逐一介紹，並對解決之道詳加說明。有觸及民間權益者，例如民間互助會，使用票據之常識，海峽兩岸婚姻，汽車肇事與保險責任及軍人及其家屬優待條例等均一併介紹。
description.en: This course-through carefully examining individual cases that often happen-helps understand more about legal knowledge so that they would cherish their endowed rights and protect themselves from being hurt. This course also encourages the students to serve the duty of laws in the hope that "All People Know The Laws and All People Follow The Laws." Thecontents: Introduction to General Principles, Provisions of Obligations, Family and Succession. Cases that have much to do with the daily life are picked up for discussion. Other topics like the mutual self-help funds, the use of checks, cross-strait marriages, vehicle accidents, insurance, bonus regulations on the military servicemen and their family are also included.

notes: 106-108：民主與法治選修。109 (含) 後：社會與法治

description.zh: 本課程名稱為 “環境與自然保育” 。它包括二大範疇：(1) 自然環境和自然資源的保育，(2) 自然環境的保存、維護、利用、復原及改良。它將教導學生下列主題：自然保育的基本概念（自然保育的定義、自然保育觀念的發展）、保育生物學（物種形成和滅絕、生物多樣性、物種保護的優先原則、生物入侵）、生態經濟學簡介（生態經濟學的原則、能量流與物質流分析）、自然保護區（自然保護區之概念、自然保護區的保護對象）、自然保育政策（國際自然保育策略、台灣的自然保育機構及相關法規）與自然保育運動（自然保育運動之發展、當前自然保育運動所關心的事）。整體而言，本課程期盼提升公民生態意識和環境覺知，使大家對環境保育做出更多貢獻。
description.en: The title of this course is “Environment and Nature Conservation”. It includes two categories: (1) conservation of the natural environment and natural resources, and (2) the preservation, maintenance, restoration and improvement of the natural environment. It will introduce to students the following themes: basic concepts of nature conservation, conservation biology, introduction to ecological economics, nature reservation, nature conservation policy, and nature conservation movement. As a whole, it aims to raise our citizens’ ecological consciousness and environmental awareness and thus enable them to make more contribution to the conservation of our environment.

notes: 106-108：自然與科學選修。109 (含) 後：自然與科學

description.zh: 創業與財務概論課程的主要目的是要使學生了解如何在企業創立的時候，透過財務技術，來評估企業的經營績效與價值。本課程將介紹以下內容：(1) 公司創業的財務報表與科目報導與分析 (2) 基本創業財務分析理論 (3) 公司的償債能力、獲利能力、經營能力、資本結構、現金流量的分析 (4) 特殊行業的財務報表分析 (5) 探討我國最近發佈的會計準則公報對企業與投資人的影響。
description.en: The goal of the introduction to entrepreneurship and finance course is to help students, when the company is in the stage of entrepreneurship, evaluate the performance and measure the values of firms by financial statements. The topics of this course includes (1) entrepreneurship financial reports and analysis; (2) basic entrepreneurship financial statement analysis; 3) solvency, profitability, business performance, financial structure and cash flow analysis; 4) financial statement analysis of special industries 5) recent developments of GAAP.

notes: 106-108：創新與創業選修。109 (含) 後：創新與創業
